title: Viral Content & Affiliate Growth Coordinator
description:
About Soma Circuit



Soma Circuit is a nervous-system regulation app founded by an Australian clinical psychologist. We create practical, evidence-informed tools to help people regulate when they feel overwhelmed, flat or steady.



We are looking for a highly capable, creative and fast-learning Viral Content & Affiliate Growth Coordinator to join the business and grow into a full-time role. We are looking for someone with an IQ of 120+ and will kindly ask for shortlisted applicants to complete an IQ test as part of the screening process. 



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who can combine strong short-form content creation with disciplined outreach and social-media execution.



The role will be approximately:



60% Social Media Content Creation & Management

40?filiate, Creator & Practitioner Outreach



The founder will provide the core psychology ideas, brand direction, app messaging, viral-format inspiration and final approvals. Your role will be to turn those ideas into compelling content and execute the growth system consistently.



Hours and progression

Weeks 1–4: 24 hours/week

Weeks 5–8: 32 hours/week



Week 9 onward: progression toward full-time, based on strong performance



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Soma Circuit long term.



Starting pay: US$6/hour, with pay reviews as responsibilities and performance increase.



60% — Content creation and social-media management



You will:

Research high-performing TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts formats.

Identify viral hooks, storytelling structures and content trends relevant to psychology, wellness, relationships, burnout, ADHD and nervous-system regulation.

Turn founder-provided ideas into engaging short-form scripts.

Generate multiple hooks and creative variations for testing.

Edit short-form videos using CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar tools.

Create polished but platform-native content that does not feel like traditional advertising.

Repurpose one strong content idea into several versions.

Adapt videos for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts,
 and 
.

Create Canva graphics, carousels, covers and thumbnails.

Write platform-specific captions and CTAs.

Schedule and publish approved content.

Maintain an organised content calendar.

Monitor views, retention, engagement and other performance indicators.

Identify winning formats and create improved variations.

Use AI tools to increase production speed and creative output.

We are particularly interested in someone who understands why content performs, not just someone who can make attractive videos.



40% — Affiliate, creator and practitioner outreach



You will:

Research relevant creators, psychologists, coaches and wellness practitioners.

Identify potential affiliate partners in Australia, the UK and the USA.

Research each prospect carefully before contact.

Draft personalised
s and direct messages using approved templates.

Use ChatGPT or other AI tools to assist with personalisation without inventing information.

Manage follow-ups consistently.

Maintain an accurate CRM or outreach database.

Support affiliate onboarding.

Provide approved links, resources and promotional materials.

Track which partners have been contacted, responded, joined or generated results.

Maintain a professional, warm and respectful communication style.

AI-first working style

Soma Circuit actively uses AI to improve productivity.



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to:



Analyse viral content.

Generate hook variations.

Improve scripts.

Adapt content between platforms.

Draft outreach.

Review captions and replies.

Summarise analytics.

Build and improve workflows.

AI should make you faster and more capable, but you are responsible for final quality, accuracy and judgement.



Essential skills



Excellent written English.

Strong creative instincts.

Experience creating TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts.

Strong short-form video-editing ability.

Canva experience.

Good understanding of social-media hooks, retention and storytelling.

Excellent online research skills.

Strong organisation and attention to detail.

Comfortable using ChatGPT or similar AI tools.

Able to take feedback and improve quickly.

Reliable and comfortable with both creative work and repetitive follow-up.



Highly regarded



Evidence that your content has significantly outperformed the follower count of the account.

Experience creating viral or high-performing short-form content.

Affiliate or influencer outreach experience.

Cold
 or partnership outreach experience.

Interest in psychology, mental health, wellness or human behaviour.

Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, Metricool, Buffer, Airtable or Notion.

Experience using AI for content production.



What success looks like



Within the first few months, you should be able to:

Produce a reliable flow of strong short-form content.

Generate and test multiple creative hooks each week.

Consistently publish across Soma Circuit’s major platforms.

Identify which content formats are gaining traction.

Maintain an organised affiliate and practitioner outreach pipeline.

Follow up reliably with prospective partners.

Help grow app awareness, trials, affiliates and paid subscribers.



How to apply



Before you apply - ask yourself this questions



- Am I a good match to the criteria above? if so, please continue. Only very serious and suitable candidates are encourage to apply

- Are you happy to start with an initial salary of US$6 per hour - with a review after the probation period of 12 weeks? I am happy to pay you much more if I can see that you are a good fit. 



If this is you, i kindly ask that message me and answer these questions to get started:



Why are you interested in this role?

Can you commit to 24 hours/week initially, progressing to 32 hours and potentially full-time?

What current clients or employment commitments do you have?

Provide links to your three best short-form videos.

For each video, explain what you personally contributed.

Which video you created achieved the strongest organic performance, and why do you think it worked?

Write three different hooks for this topic: “Why slowing down can sometimes make an anxious person feel worse at first.”

Describe how you would turn one Soma Circuit video into content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn.

Describe any experience you have with creator, affiliate or cold
 outreach.

Which AI tools do you currently use?

Give one example of how AI has made your work significantly faster or better.

Confirm your expected hourly rate.



*** Please start your response with the phrasing "Regulated, not fixed" - this is a filter to see if applicants are really actually reading the description - rather than skimming it. I want someone who has good attention to detail.



1. A short timed cognitive ability assessment

This will assess problem-solving, logical reasoning, verbal reasoning and learning speed. It is designed to be completed independently without AI assistance or outside help.



2. A short practical assessment

Candidates who perform strongly will complete a brief practical task based on the actual work involved in this role. This will include analysing a short-form social-media concept, developing hooks/content ideas and demonstrating how they would approach affiliate or practitioner outreach.



3. Final interview

The strongest candidates will then be invited to a video interview to discuss their thinking, experience, creative judgement and approach to the role.

The practical assessment will be kept short and focused. Any substantial work requested from final-stage candidates will be paid.

title: AWS / Linux Infrastructure Engineer (US Night Shift, Full Time)
description:
ABOUT US



Shopper Approved is an established US-based SaaS company serving about 3,000 clients. We run an AWS-hosted PHP/Laravel platform and work asynchronously with a development team in Pakistan. Our staff is distributed across the United States, Mexico, and the Philippines. This is a permanent, full-time, 100% remote role.



THE ROLE



You own the infrastructure side of a live production SaaS platform. You keep it healthy and recoverable, you make deployments safer, and you replace manual server work with automation that actually holds up. A separate specialist owns employee IT and helpdesk — you will never be asked to reset someone's password or fix a printer.



This is a real production-ownership role. You will hold privileged access to systems that 3,000 paying clients depend on. We are looking for someone who has carried that weight before and treats it seriously.



READ THIS FIRST — SCHEDULE



Working hours are 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Mountain Time, Monday through Friday.



In Philippine time that is:



9:00 PM to 6:00 AM PHT (mid-March through early November)

10:00 PM to 7:00 AM PHT (early November through mid-March)



Yes, this is a permanent night shift. The one-hour move twice a year is US daylight saving; the Philippines does not observe it, so your local hours shift with ours. Only apply if you can hold this schedule reliably, year-round, long term.



The upside of this schedule: you overlap with US leadership for essentially your entire shift, and with our development team in Pakistan for roughly the first five hours. You will not be working in isolation.



Occasional approved maintenance windows or critical i
 may fall outside your regular hours. This is not continuous 24/7 on-call coverage, and we do not expect you to be reachable around the clock.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Day-to-day AWS and Linux production infrastructure operations

Ubuntu application servers, Nginx/Apache, PHP-FPM, queues, workers, scheduled jobs, TLS, storage, and capacity

EC2, RDS, VPC, IAM, S3, monitoring, backup, restoration, i
 triage, and cost signals

Golden/base AMI creation, patching, validation, promotion, rollback, and retirement

Datadog and CloudWatch observability, and alerts that are actually actionable

Platform readiness, post-deploy validation, and rollback support for deployments initiated by our development partner from Bitbucket

Infrastructure automation, source-controlled operational change, runbooks, and clean asynchronous handoffs

Reviewed security, IAM, network, backup, and cost improvements



WHAT YOU WILL NOT OWN



Employee laptops, SaaS access,
 quarantine, onboarding/offboarding, printers, or office helpdesk

Application feature development

Unilateral high-risk architecture changes or production-network migration

Any physical or onsite work

Sole 24/7 coverage



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Three or more years of hands-on Linux and cloud operations, or equivalent depth you can demonstrate

Production AWS work with EC2, RDS, VPC, IAM, S3, monitoring, and backups

Production web operations with Nginx or Apache, plus real process and service troubleshooting

Repeatable patching, image creation, configuration management, or infrastructure-as-code

Deployment, rollback, i
 response, and restoration you have actually tested — not just configured

Bash, Python, or another practical automation language

Strong written English and sound judgment with privileged production access

A reliable primary internet connection and a practical backup plan (mobile data, second ISP, or a nearby fallback location)



HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED



PHP/Laravel, PHP-FPM, Supervisor, or Laravel Horizon operations

Datadog APM, logs, and metrics; Cloudflare

Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Packer, or EC2 Image Builder

Migrating legacy infrastructure into something repeatable

SOC 2 or another evidence-driven control environment



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Genuine ownership of the platform, with the authority to fix root causes instead of patching symptoms

Direct access to US leadership during your shift — no layers between you and a decision

A documented environment and a defined scope

Long-term stability; we are hiring for years, not for a project



COMPENSATION



$1200 USD per month, depending on demonstrated experience and the final employment arrangement. Local-currency payment, benefits, leave, holidays, equipment, and after-hours terms will be written into the offer. Night-shift hours are reflected in the rate.



HOW WE HIRE



A structured screen focused on production systems you personally owned

A scenario-based technical and security interview

A paid 90-minute synthetic production-i
 assessment

A live defense of your work, with the facts changed on you

References from people who directly observed your production work



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word SNAPSHOT so we know you read the whole posting. Applications without it are not reviewed.



Then answer these six questions directly. Be specific — vague answers get filtered immediately.



Describe the largest production environment you personally operated. How many servers, roughly what traffic, and what was your actual scope of responsibility?

Walk us through one production i
 you handled end to end. What broke, how did you find it, what did you do, and what did you change afterward so it could not happen again?

Have you personally performed a real restore from backup — not a configuration, an actual restore? Describe it.

What have you automated that replaced manual server work? Tools, approach, and what it saved.

Confirm you can reliably work 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM PHT (10:00 PM to 7:00 AM during US winter), Monday through Friday, year-round. Describe your internet setup and your backup plan.

What monthly rate are you looking for?



Please do not send a generic cover letter or a copy-pasted résumé blast. We read every application that follows these instructions.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable to fulfill this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person who contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

description:
About Us



We are a specialist property and real estate recruitment agency based in Australia. We partner with leading developers, commercial property groups, asset owners, agencies, and build-to-rent operators across Queensland and nationally.



We're looking for a highly skilled Talent Resourcer to support our consultants by identifying and mapping talent, building candidate pipelines, and leveraging AI to streamline recruitment processes.



This is a research-focused role with no candidate calling or sales activity required.



Key Responsibilities



• Conduct candidate searches using LinkedIn Recruiter, SEEK Talent Search, and other sourcing platforms • Build targeted candidate lists based on detailed recruitment briefs • Create and refine Boolean search strings for niche and hard-to-fill roles • Map competitors, target companies, and talent pools across specific industries • Identify passive candidates and collect relevant market intelligence • Utilise AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Claude to assist with sourcing, research, job advertisements and administrative tasks • Draft engaging job advertisements from client briefs • Maintain accurate candidate records and sourcing notes within our CRM • Assist with market mapping projects and talent pipeline development



What We're Looking For



• Previous experience in recruitment sourcing, talent research, executive search, or recruitment administration • Strong Boolean search skills • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and/or SEEK Talent Search • Strong internet research and data gathering skills • High attention to detail and accuracy • Excellent written English • Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity • Able to work independently and meet deadlines • Reliable internet connection and home office setup



What Success Looks Like



• Consultants receive well-targeted candidate lists ready for outreach • Accurate and detailed talent maps are produced for client assignments • Boolean searches consistently identify candidates not found through simple keyword searches • Job advertisements are created quickly and professionally using AI tools • Research projects are delivered accurately and on time



Benefits



• Fully remote position • No phone-based sales or candidate calling required • Flexible working arrangements • Work directly with an experienced Australian recruitment team



To Apply



Please include:



A brief summary of your recruitment or sourcing experience

An example of a Boolean search you've created



Ideal rate: AUD $5-8/hour depending on experience and capability.

title: Social Media & Content Manager — Long-Term Position
description:
# Social Media & Content Manager — Long-Term Position



We are looking for a **full
-term Social Media & Content Manager** to help manage and grow a personal brand and software company across multiple social media platforms.



We need someone who is **extremely consistent, organized, creative, and proactive.**



The biggest priority is CONSISTENCY.



We want to be posting **every single day** across:



* TikTok

* Instagram

* YouTube

* Snapchat

* X /



You will help take content, ideas, raw footage, finished videos, testimonials, software updates, and other assets and turn them into consistent daily content across all platforms.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



**Daily Posting & Management**



* Make sure content is posted consistently every day

* Upload and schedule TikToks, Reels and YouTube Shorts

* Create and post Instagram Stories

* Help maintain daily Snapchat activity

* Write and publish posts/tweets on X

* Write captions, titles, hooks and CTAs

* Make sure we NEVER simply forget to post



**Content Repurposing**



* Take one piece of content and find multiple ways to use it

* Turn TikToks into Reels and YouTube Shorts

* Pull ideas/quotes from videos for X posts

* Turn results, testimonials and screenshots into Stories/posts

* Adapt content appropriately for each platform



**Content Planning**



* Build weekly and daily content calendars

* Tell me EXACTLY what content I need to film

* Organize raw footage and completed content

* Keep track of what is being edited, ready to post, scheduled and already posted

* Make sure we always have content prepared ahead of time



**Content Ideas & Research**



* Research viral/trending content

* Find TikTok/Reels/Shorts formats we can recreate

* Research competitors and successful creators

* Bring us specific content ideas, hooks and references

* Help come up with content around TikTok Shop, entrepreneurship, software, creators and building businesses



**Software Content**

We also operate Creator Toolbox, a software platform built for creators and brands.



You will help create and manage content for the software, including:



* Feature demonstrations

* Product updates

* Creator/brand educational content

* Testimonials/results

* Short-form promotional content

* Social posts

* Stories

* 
s/trending formats

* Calls to action

* Behind-the-scenes content



A lot of this content should be something you can eventually create WITHOUT needing me to personally film every post.



**Working With Editors**

We have video editors who will handle much of the editing.



You may also be responsible for:



* Sending raw footage to editors

* Giving editors references/instructions

* Reviewing completed videos

* Requesting revisions

* Organizing finished videos

* Scheduling/posting approved content



You do NOT need to personally edit every video.



## What We're Looking For



We want someone who:



* Has experience managing social media accounts

* Understands TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat and X

* Understands short-form content

* Understands hooks, retention and viral content

* Is VERY organized

* Communicates quickly

* Can work independently

* Can follow instructions

* Can learn my personal content/writing style

* Can write naturally in English

* Can research trends and competitors

* Can manage multiple accounts at once

* Is comfortable working with video editors

* Can consistently get things done WITHOUT needing to be reminded

* Wants a long-term position



You should be PROACTIVE.



I don't want to have to message every day asking:



"Did we post today?"



You should be the person reminding ME:



"We need these 3 videos filmed today."



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of these questions:



1. What social media accounts have you managed? Please send links/examples.



2. Which platforms do you have experience managing: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat and X/Twitter?



3. Which platform are you strongest at?



4. Have you managed a personal brand before?



5. Have you managed a business/software social media account before?



6. Can you create basic social media graphics/content yourself?



7. Can you edit short-form videos? If yes, what software do you use?



8. Have you worked with separate video editors before?



9. How would you turn ONE TikTok video into content for all five of our platforms?



10. How would you make sure every account gets posted on every day without me reminding you?



11. How do you research viral content and trends?



12. How would you organize raw footage ? editing ? revisions ? approved ? scheduled ? posted?



13. If I didn't send you enough new footage one week, what would you do to keep the accounts active?



14. What hours are you available?



15. Are you looking for a long-term position?



**IMPORTANT:** Start your application with the words **"CONTENT EVERY DAY"** so I know you actually read the entire job post.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team long-term. As our brands and platforms grow, there will be opportunities for the role to grow as well.

title: Join Our Team as a Medical Billing & Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant
description:
Medical Billing & Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant (Medicare Billing | CharmHealth | QuickBooks | GoHighLevel)



Are you an experienced, detail-oriented Medical Virtual Assistant with hands-on experience in Medicare billing, bookkeeping, and patient account management?



My name is Dr. Alyson, and I own a growing private medical practice in Florida, USA, focused on primary care, weight management, metabolic health, and menopause care.



I am looking for a reliable and proactive Medical Billing & Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant to help manage the billing and financial administrative side of my practice.



This is a part-time position requiring approximately 5–10 hours per week. I have a small practice, however, accuracy, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through are extremely important.



I am looking for someone who can take ownership of these responsibilities and help make sure claims are submitted correctly, payments are tracked, patient accounts are accurate, and my financial records stay organized.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Medicare Billing & Claims Management

*Hands-on Medicare Part B billing experience is required.*



Responsibilities will include:

Preparing and submitting Medicare Part B claims

Reviewing claims for accuracy prior to submission

Monitoring claim status

Correcting and resubmitting rejected claims

Researching and working denied claims

Following claims through payment

Identifying missing or incorrect provider, payer, diagnosis, or claim information

Verifying Medicare eligibility when needed

Assisting with ERA/EFT and payer enrollment issues

Communicating with Medicare or payer representatives when necessary

Tracking outstanding claims and unresolved billing issues

Maintaining organized billing records

Identifying billing problems and taking initiative to help resolve them



CharmHealth / CharmEHR

*Experience with CharmHealth/CharmEHR is strongly preferred*



Particularly experience with:

Claim creation and submission

Insurance billing

Claim tracking

Rejections and denials

ERA/payment posting

Patient accounts



*If you have strong Medicare billing experience using another EHR but are comfortable learning CharmHealth, I am still interested in hearing from you.*



*Experience with GoHighLevel is highly preferred.*

The majority of my practice is cash-pay.

I use GoHighLevel for patient invoicing, recurring payments, and other patient payment workflows.



Responsibilities may include:

Creating and reviewing patient invoices

Monitoring recurring payments

Identifying failed or overdue payments

Following up on outstanding patient balances

Reviewing patient account activity

Helping reconcile payments and deposits

Troubleshooting basic invoice and payment issues

Maintaining accurate patient financial records

Assisting with payment workflows and automations



QuickBooks & Bookkeeping

*Experience with QuickBooks Online and bookkeeping is required*



Responsibilities may include:

Setting up and managing Chart of Accounts

Categorizing business transactions

Reviewing income and expenses

Matching payments and deposits

Reconciling bank and credit card accounts

Identifying duplicate, missing, or incorrectly categorized transactions

Maintaining organized bookkeeping records

Preparing basic financial reports or spreadsheets as requested

Helping ensure my books are organized and ready for review by my CPA



You will not be replacing my CPA. I am looking for someone who can help keep the day-to-day bookkeeping accurate and organized.



*Credentialing experience is NOT required, but any experience with physician or medical practice credentialing and enrollment with Commercial Insurance Plans and Medicare Advantage plans would be a significant plus.*



Helpful experience may include:

Medicare Advantage payer applications

Provider enrollment and network participation

CAQH maintenance and re-attestation

PECOS

NPPES/NPI information

Type 1 and Type 2 NPI enrollment

Individual provider and group enrollment

Payer portals

Credentialing application follow-up

Provider roster management

EFT/ERA enrollment

Tracking application status, approval, and effective dates







Other Administrative Responsibilities



Because this is a small medical practice, you may occasionally help with other administrative tasks as time allows, including:

Patient administrative follow-up

Organizing documents and spreadsheets

Practice
 management

Updating forms or SOPs

Research

CRM organization

General practice operations



This is NOT primarily a social media or marketing position.



Experience with Canva, newsletters, social media, content creation, or digital marketing is a bonus, but billing, bookkeeping, and financial organization are the priority.



YOU WOULD BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

Have hands-on Medicare Part B billing experience

Have personally submitted medical claims

Have experience correcting rejected claims and working denials

Understand the claims process from submission through payment

Have strong attention to detail

Are highly organized

Follow through until problems are actually resolved

Are comfortable independently researching billing issues

Take initiative instead of waiting for detailed instructions for every task

Have excellent written and spoken English

Can clearly explain problems and proposed solutions

Are comfortable working with financial information

Understand the importance of patient confidentiality

Are reliable and consistent

Want a long-term position with a growing medical practice



YOU ARE PROBABLY NOT A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

Have healthcare VA experience but have never personally submitted insurance claims

Have no Medicare billing experience

Need step-by-step instructions for every task

Frequently leave tasks unfinished without follow-up

Struggle with attention to detail

Are uncomfortable troubleshooting rejected or denied claims

Have difficulty managing multiple small tasks independently

Simply report that something “doesn't work” without attempting to identify the cause or solution



SOFTWARE & EXPERIENCE

Required:

Medicare Part B billing experience

Healthcare/medical office experience

QuickBooks Online



Strongly Preferred:

CharmHealth / CharmEHR

GoHighLevel



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Reliable high-speed internet

Reliable computer

Webcam and microphone for Google Meet

Ability to securely access healthcare systems

Availability for meetings during U.S. Eastern Time



HEALTHCARE & PRIVACY



Because you will have access to confidential patient and financial information:

HIPAA compliance is mandatory

Strict patient confidentiality is required

You must be comfortable working with medical terminology

Financial information must be handled carefully and confidentially

HIPAA training will be provided as needed



HOURS & SCHEDULE

Part-time, Approximately 5–10 hours per week

100% remote

Some availability or overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required

Schedule can be flexible depending on responsibilities

Weekly or scheduled Google Meet check-ins as needed

Potential for increased hours as the practice grows



COMPENSATION

Starting rate: $4/hour

Performance review after the initial 1-month probationary period

Opportunity for performance-based raises

Potential for additional hours and responsibilities as the practice grows



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



I am looking for someone who can eventually become my go-to person for billing and financial administrative workflows, and grow wants to grow with the practice long-term.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your Resume

Include your previous healthcare, billing, bookkeeping, and virtual assistant experience.



2.  Minute Video Introduction



Please introduce yourself and briefly tell me about your medical billing experience, your work style, and why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Also include answers to the following questions in your intro video:



How many years of medical billing experience do you have, and what experience do you have billing Medicare Part B?

1. Have you personally submitted claims and worked Medicare claim rejections or denials? Please briefly describe your experience.

2. Have you used CharmHealth/CharmEHR? If yes, what functions did you perform?

3. Describe your experience with QuickBooks Online and bookkeeping. What bookkeeping tasks have you personally performed?

4. Describe your experience with GoHighLevel. Have you used it for invoicing, recurring payments, subscriptions, payment collection, or payment follow-up?



If you have read this entire job posting, include the word “unicorn” somewhere in your application.



If you have strong Medicare billing skills, enjoy keeping financial systems organized, and take pride in making sure things are done correctly and completely, I would love to hear from you.



Dr. Alyson

nt should go.



Your job is to find the story inside the footage.

Episodes may include:



aviation and learning to fly;

farms and physical work;

motorsports and extreme experiences;

unusual American professions and subcultures;

interviews combined with real-life action and experiences.

Strong storytelling and sense of narrative.

Dynamic pacing that maintains viewer attention.

Ability to identify the strongest emotional 
nts in raw footage.

Creative use of B-roll and cutaways.

Professional sound design.

Professional color correction and consistent visual style.

We will provide the footage and explain the overall story and important 
nts. From there, we expect you to propose creative solutions and build the episode rather than waiting for frame-by-frame instructions.

title: Real Estate Agent Acquisitions Rep (Remote)
description:
About REI Cornerstone



We’re a real estate investment company buying distressed properties across NC, SC, and FL. We source deals primarily through real estate agents. We’re growing and looking for a driven, phone?savvy Agent Acquisitions Rep to own agent outreach and bring in contracts.







What You Will Be Doing



Make 150–200 outbound calls or 40-50 conversations per day to real estate agents to introduce our company and our buying criteria

Build and manage a pipeline of agent relationships in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

Follow a proven script, handle basic objections, and ask for opportunities and offers

Collect property details from agents and pass qualified deals to the acquisitions manager

Log every call, note, and next step in the CRM 

Hit weekly KPIs on calls, conversations and properties acquired





Who Is This For?



You’ve worked in phone?heavy sales (call center, telemarketing, D2D, inside sales, etc.)

You’re comfortable in commission?heavy roles and like being paid on performance

You can handle high activity: 150–200 dials/day is exciting, not scary

You’re disciplined with CRM and scripts (you can follow a process)

Strong spoken and written English; confident talking to U.S. real estate agents

Available Mon–Fri, 9–5 Eastern (full?time, remote)





Compensation:



$4 per hour base 

2% of assignment fees

Total Pay Range (Base + Commission) per month: $800-$1,500/month starting out should progress closer to $1,400-$2,000/month.

Clear path to higher commissions and responsibilities based on results





How To Apply:



Apply through LinkedIn and answer the screening questions.

If selected, you’ll receive a short PDF + video about our process.

You MUST review them and complete a short task before the interview. Applications that skip this are not considered.

Your application is the first ad you will ever write for us.

title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant – Canadian Market (Paragon | BC | PST Hours)
description:
Real Estate Virtual Assistant — West Coast Living (Oakwyn Realty)

???? Remote | Full-Time | Philippine-Based Applicants | PST Hours (9 AM – 6 PM)





Who We Are

West Coast Living is a top-producing real estate team based in Vancouver, BC, operating under Oakwyn Realty. We specialize in residential resale, presale project marketing, rental property management, and developer-facing listing services. We are a fast-moving, highly collaborative team that takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally.

We are looking for a seasoned Real Estate Virtual Assistant who is ready to grow with us long-term. This is not a general admin role. This is a career opportunity for someone who knows Canadian real estate, speaks the language, understands the systems, and wants to be a real part of a professional team.





The Role

You will be embedded into our team,  attending meetings, communicating directly with agents and clients, and supporting the full transaction and marketing cycle. You will be relied on for accuracy, speed, professionalism, and initiative. If we succeed, you succeed. We believe in recognizing and rewarding the people who show up and deliver.





What You Will Do

Transaction & Listing Support

Prepare, organize, and track listing documents including MLS input forms, Schedule A/B addenda, and BCREA contracts

Enter and update listings on Paragon MLS — including photos, room measurements, strata details, and listing remarks

Manage document collection and completion checklists for active listings and buyer files

Follow up with lawyers, notaries, and conveyancers on missing items and completion milestones

Maintain accurate records in the team CRM (Reach)

Prepare showing feedback summaries and market update reports for clients



Administrative & Operations

Manage and organize Google Drive and Dropbox folders — naming conventions, version control, archiving

Draft and proofread client-facing
s, letters, and follow-up messages in a warm, professional tone

Prepare and manage web forms, online applications, and digital document submissions

Maintain team calendars, schedule showings, and coordinate appointments

Research properties, strata documents, title histories, and building profiles using online tools

Source and verify information from BC Assessment, Stratapress, Strata Plan Registry, and other public records

Support presale marketing files including unit trackers, price lists, and developer correspondence



Communication & Team Participation

Attend team meetings via Zoom or Google Meet (PST hours — 8 AM to 5 PM Monday to Friday)

Communicate responsively via WhatsApp and
 with team members and clients

Flag issues proactively — if something is missing, unclear, or time-sensitive, you speak up

Support the team lead with personal organization, task tracking, and project follow-up





What You Need to Bring

Non-Negotiable Requirements:

Minimum 2–3 years of real estate experience — either in a Canadian real estate office, with a Canadian real estate team, or supporting a Canadian broker or agent remotely

Solid working knowledge of Paragon MLS — including listing entry, status updates, and photo uploads

Familiarity with Canadian real estate forms, terminology, and transaction stages (Accepted Offer, Subject Removal, Completion, Possession)

Fluent written and spoken English — your
s, documents, and verbal communication must be professional and clear

Advanced skills in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail, Calendar) and Dropbox

Experience with web forms, digital documents, and e-signature tools (DocuSign or similar)

Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy under pressure

Reliable internet with minimum 25 Mbps upload/download — you must provide your speed test result

Backup internet plan for outages (mobile hotspot, nearby café, or generator) — tell us your plan



Strong Assets:

Experience with Canva for real estate marketing materials

Experience with presale project marketing or new development real estate

Familiarity with BC real estate specifics: strata, depreciation reports, Form B, PTT, FINTRAC

Proactive with technology — you don't just use tools, you suggest better ones

Experience supporting a team lead or broker in a client-facing real estate environment





Work Setup & Availability

This role works Vancouver time (Pacific Standard / Pacific Daylight Time) — Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. This is a hard requirement. Our clients and our market operate on this schedule, and you will be expected to be present and responsive during these hours.



We will ask you:

What is your current internet speed? (Please include a screenshot of a recent speed test from fast.com or speedtest.net)

Does your city/area experience frequent typhoons, power outages, or weather-related disruptions?

What is your backup plan if your primary internet goes down? (Mobile data, nearby café, generator — please describe)

We have experienced connectivity issues with previous VAs during weather events. We take this seriously and expect an honest, detailed answer.





Who Thrives on This Team

You are organized to the point that other people notice. You communicate before you're asked. You read a document all the way through before responding. You notice when something doesn't add up. You are proud of the quality of your work and you take ownership of your file like it's yours.



You want to build something — not just fill a role. You are looking for a team that will invest in you and give you room to grow. You are not looking for a side gig. You are looking for a career.





How to Apply — Read This Carefully

?? Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Subject Line

Your subject line must read exactly: "WCL VA – [Your Name] – I Read the Whole Thing"

Any other subject line tells us you did not read this ad.



Step 2 — Your Application

In the body of your application, answer the following in order:

Briefly describe one real estate transaction or file you supported from start to finish — what was your role and what happened?

List every MLS system or real estate software you have used and how long you used each

What is the difference between Subject Removal and Completion in a BC real estate transaction? (Answer in your own words — do not Google this. If you know Canadian real estate, you know this.)

What is your internet speed and what is your backup plan for outages?

What city are you located in, and does it experience typhoons or storm-related outages? How do you handle this?

Tell us one tool or process you introduced in a previous role that made the team more efficient



Step 3 — Attachments

Your application must include:

Your updated resume (PDF preferred)

A portfolio or work sample — this can be a Canva design, a document you created, a spreadsheet you built, or any piece of work that shows us the quality of what you produce. If you do not have a portfolio, create a short sample — a listing description, a formatted table, a one-page summary of anything. This is your chance to show us how you work.

A screenshot of your internet speed test (from fast.com or speedtest.net)





Compensation & What We Offer

We pay for skill, experience, and reliability — not the lowest rate we can find. This is a long-term role and we compensate accordingly.



Base Rate:

$9.00 – $11.00 CDN per hour, full-time (40 hours/week), based on experience and demonstrated Canadian real estate knowledge.



What's Included:

Competitive base rate reviewed after your first 120 days

Performance-based increases — if the team grows, your compensation grows with it

13th month bonus (paid annually — this is a standard we honour without exception)

10 paid days off per year

A stable, long-term position with a professional and supportive team environment

Direct access to the team lead and agents — you are not working in isolation



We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for the right person. If you bring the skills, the professionalism, and the commitment — we will take care of you and grow together.





What to Expect

Qualified applicants will be contacted for a short written screening, followed by a video interview over Google Meet. We move quickly with candidates who demonstrate they are the right fit.



This is a long-term role with a team that takes care of its people. If you are serious about real estate, serious about quality, and ready to work hard alongside people who will do the same — we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Finance & Operations Manager (CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Position: Senior Finance & Operations Manager (CPA Preferred)



Location: Remote (Philippines)



Overview

We are a growing Canadian construction and service company looking for someone who wants more than a traditional accounting role.



We're looking for a reliable, proactive, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of our finance and administrative operations. This person will play a key role in helping leadership make informed decisions, maintain healthy cash flow, and ensure the business runs smoothly behind the scenes.



The ideal candidate is a self-motivated leader who anticipates business needs before they arise. We value a professional who communicates with clarity, maintains flawless organization, and demonstrates a relentless commitment to following through on every initiative.



Key Responsibilities

- Full cycle bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online

- Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable

- Weekly cash flow forecasting and reporting

- Bank reconciliations and payment scheduling

- Monitor company cash position and flag potential cash flow issues early

- Follow up on outstanding customer payments

- Payroll support and payroll reconciliations

- Budget tracking and financial analysis

- Assist with month end and year end preparation

- Work closely with our Canadian CPA

- Maintain financial records and support compliance requirements

- Assist with HR administration and employee records

- Improve internal processes, documentation, and financial controls

- Keep leadership informed of important deadlines, risks, and priorities

- Help create reports that support business growth and decision making



Who are we looking for

- CPA preferred

- Has experience supporting Canadian companies

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Strong understanding of cash flow management

- Superior proficiency in written and verbal English

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Honest, dependable, and accountable

- Able to manage confidential financial information with integrity

- Comfortable working independently while keeping leadership informed

- Positive attitude and willingness to continuously improve systems



What Success Looks Like



Within the first six months, you will:



- Keep financial records accurate and up to date.

- Ensure payments and payroll are processed on time.

- Maintain reliable cash flow forecasts that support decision making.

- Proactively identify financial risks before they become problems.

- Improve at least two internal processes that increase efficiency or accuracy.

- Become a trusted member of the leadership team through consistency, communication, and accountability.



If you're looking for a long term opportunity where your work truly makes an impact, we'd love to hear from you.



Please send your resume, expected monthly salary, and a short introduction explaining why you're the right fit for this role.

s

PHASE 5: PAID CLIENT FUNNEL + ONBOARDING

 sequences

 Marketing

Exceptional attention to detail

Strong research and organizational skills

Experience tailoring resumes and cover letters for specific job postings

Understanding of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and strategies for improving resume visibility

Reliable internet connection

title: Experienced GoHighLevel Specialist – CRM, AI, Automations & Funnels
description:
Starting Pay: $7.00 USD/hour — NON-NEGOTIABLE

IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER OR ENTRY-LEVEL GHL POSITION.



We are looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to become a key technical resource for multiple home improvement and lead-generation businesses.



Please do not apply if you are currently learning GoHighLevel, have only basic experience building funnels, or require step-by-step instructions for normal GHL functions.



We need someone who already understands GHL well enough to build, troubleshoot, research, test and solve problems independently.



The starting rate for this position is $7.00 USD per hour. This starting rate is firm and is not negotiable. Please do not apply asking for a higher starting rate.



What We Need



This is much more than a funnel-building position.



We need someone capable of handling the technical side of our GoHighLevel infrastructure and eventually taking significant ownership over our CRM, automations, AI systems and funnels.



You should have strong working knowledge of:



GHL CRM setup and management

Advanced workflows and automations

Pipelines and opportunities

Custom fields, tags and contact management

Calendars and appointment scheduling

Lead routing and qualification

GHL Voice AI

GHL Conversation AI/chatbots

AI prompts and knowledge bases

Phone numbers and call routing

SMS and
 automations

Forms, surveys and chat widgets

Funnels and landing pages

 and Google lead 

Tracking and attribution

Webhooks and third-party integrations

User access and GHL configuration

Troubleshooting existing GHL systems

Testing systems before they are deployed



Experience with Zapier, Make, APIs, webhooks, JavaScript or custom integrations is a major advantage.



The Level of Independence We Expect



We will sometimes provide extremely detailed instructions. Other times, you will be given an objective and expected to determine the technical solution.



For example, we may say:



“Build an after-hours AI receptionist that qualifies incoming callers, determines their service area and schedules them into the appropriate calendar.”



An experienced candidate should be capable of determining how to build the system, researching anything necessary, configuring it, testing different scenarios, identifying problems and presenting a working solution.



We are not looking for someone who stops working every time they encounter something they haven't done before.



We understand that nobody knows every feature of GoHighLevel. Research is completely acceptable and encouraged. What matters is your ability to find answers, troubleshoot problems and continue making progress independently.



If something genuinely requires administrator access or additional permissions, we expect you to identify specifically what is required and communicate it clearly.



AI & Automation



AI will be an increasingly important part of this position.



We are building systems involving:



Voice AI • Conversation AI • Automated Scheduling • Lead Qualification • CRM Automation • Automated Follow-Up • Knowledge Bases • Call Handling • Lead Routing



You should either already have strong experience with GHL's AI tools or be highly capable of working with them.



Our goal isn't simply to have AI features turned on. We want AI systems that actually work reliably with real customers.



That means testing different customer scenarios, finding weaknesses in the conversation flow and continuously improving the system.



Funnels & Lead Generation



You should also be capable of building professional, conversion-focused GHL funnels and landing pages.



Our businesses generate leads through Google,
 and other marketing channels, so these pages need to do more than look attractive.



You should understand mobile-first design, calls to action, lead capture, conversion flow, social proof, trust building, chat integration, tracking and responsive design.



We operate primarily in the home improvement and lead-generation industries, so experience with contractors or home-service businesses is a plus.



Who We Want



We are looking for someone who is:



Experienced. Technical. Resourceful. Reliable. Organized. Detail-oriented.



Most importantly, we want someone who can take ownership of a project.



When you encounter a problem, your first instinct should be to investigate it and determine the solution—not simply wait for someone else to tell you what to do.



At the same time, good communication is extremely important. If something requires information, access or a business decision from us, communicate exactly what you need.



Compensation



Starting pay: $7.00 USD per hour.



The starting rate is NON-NEGOTIABLE.



Please only apply if you are comfortable beginning at $7/hour.



We are looking for someone interested in establishing a long-term working relationship and taking on greater responsibility as our systems continue to grow.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



How many years/months have you actively worked inside GoHighLevel?

What would you rate your GHL knowledge from 1–10, and why?

Describe the most technically advanced GHL system you have personally built.

Describe your experience with GHL Voice AI.

Describe your experience with Conversation AI and AI knowledge bases.

What types of GHL workflows and automations have you built?

Have you worked with APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make or custom code? Explain.

Send examples of GHL funnels you personally built.

Send a Loom video showing us inside a GHL account or system you personally built and explain how it works.

What hours are you available to work in Eastern Time (US)?

Confirm in your application: “I understand the starting rate is $7.00 USD/hour and I am comfortable with this rate.”



Applications that do not answer the questions above may not be considered.



Please Do Not Apply If:



You are brand new to GoHighLevel, are currently taking a course to learn GHL, have primarily worked as a general VA, only know basic funnel/page building, or need extensive training before you can independently manage GHL projects.



We are hiring someone because we need GHL expertise on our team—not someone we need to teach GoHighLevel from the beginning.

description:
A growing North American facilities services organization is expanding its remote accounting support and is seeking dependable, detail-oriented professionals. This is a work-from-home independent contractor engagement supporting commercial and retail clients across Canada.



The role is paid weekly upon receipt of invoice. The schedule is 9-hour shifts, five (5) days per week. Occasional Saturday shifts (approximately once per month) may be required. Shifts align with Eastern Standard Time: 8:00–5:00, 9:00–6:00, or 10:00–7:00 EST.



Role Overview

This is a fast-moving, highly collaborative accounting support engagement within a structured, system-driven environment. Work is coordinated in real time via Zoom and internal platforms to ensure financial accuracy and maintain workflow efficiency.



As part of the accounting support function, you will work closely with internal teams, vendors, and clients, as well as play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting billing processes, and ensuring smooth daily operations.



What You’ll Do

Customer Invoicing: Generate invoices, track deposits, process purchase order invoicing, support job costing, and assist with new client setup.

Accounts Receivable & Payable Support: Post daily cash receipts, support accounts payable data entry, assist with credit card reconciliations, and coordinate vendor payments.

Collections & Follow-Up: Monitor aging reports, follow up on outstanding receivables, issue delinquency notices, and assist in resolving invoice disputes professionally and efficiently.

Financial Reporting Support: Prepare ad-hoc management reports, create financial schedules as needed, and assist with month-end close tasks.

Documentation & Compliance: Review supporting documentation, such as work orders, approvals, and sign-offs, to ensure billing accuracy and audit readiness.

Vendor & Client Communication: Serve as a professional liaison between internal teams, vendors, and customers to resolve discrepancies and maintain positive relationships.

Process Improvement: Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend improvements to strengthen accounting operations.



Requirements for Home Office Set-Up

• Preferred: Windows PC running Windows 11.

• Minimum 300 Mbps internet speed (600 Mbps preferred); fibre connection strongly preferred.

• Multiple monitors required (single monitor setups are not suitable).

• High-quality headset with microphone.

• Reliable webcam.

• Quiet, professional workspace suitable for full-day Zoom collaboration.



What You Bring

Accounting Experience: Previous experience in accounts receivable, accounts payable, invoicing, or bookkeeping support is required. Experience working in remote or virtual accounting environments preferred.

Technical Proficiency: Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel. Comfortable working across multiple systems, databases, and accounting platforms simultaneously.

Organization: You can handle high
 volumes, prioritize tasks, and keep everything on track.

Problem-solving: You take initiative, think independently, and easily resolve issues.

Collaborative Communicator: You work confidently with others, fostering accountability and motivation. You are a positive, self-motivated individual with clear communication.

Composed Under Pressure: You enjoy working within tight deadlines with close attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Position Overview

The Marketing Specialist is responsible for helping Boeshaar Law attract qualified prospective clients, strengthen referral relationships, maintain consistent visibility in the marketplace, and track the effectiveness of all marketing activities.

This position combines hands-on marketing execution with regular analytics and reporting. The goal is not simply to “do marketing,” but to help the firm understand what is working, what is not working, where leads are coming from, and which marketing activities are producing consults, retained clients, and revenue.

This role is based on the following roles, which emphasize content creation, social media, campaign management, referral source development, client communication, tracking prospective clients/referral sources/leads, and weekly reporting.



Primary Purpose of the Position

This role is designed to support the firm's marketing efforts by creating compelling content, managing social media, and executing effective marketing campaigns. The Marketing Specialist will contribute to the firm's success by enhancing its visibility and reputation, ultimately supporting business development goals.

The person in this role will coordinate and execute approved marketing activities, maintain marketing systems, support referral and client communication, and provide regular reporting on leads, prospects, consults, referral sources, campaigns, and marketing return on investment.



Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing Strategy Support and Execution

The Marketing Specialist will help implement the firm’s approved marketing plan. This includes coordinating marketing projects, tracking deadlines, following up with vendors, and making sure campaigns are completed on time.

Responsibilities include:

• Assist with developing and executing approved marketing campaigns.

• Maintain the firm’s marketing calendar.

• Coordinate daily and weekly marketing tasks.

• Work with attorneys, staff, contractors, copywriters, designers, website vendors, and other vendors.

• Keep marketing projects organized and moving forward.

• Maintain marketing materials in accessible electronic folders.

• Make recommendations for improvements based on campaign results and observed trends.

This job involves coordinating through tea
mbers, vendors, and contractors, meeting deadlines, supporting marketing workflows, and executing marketing strategies.



2. Marketing Analytics and Reporting

The Marketing Specialist will maintain a marketing analytics dashboard and provide weekly and monthly reports to the Owner. The purpose is to create a data-driven feedback system so the firm can make better marketing decisions.  Responsibilities include:

• Track all leads by source, including referrals, Google, website, paid ads, social media,
 campaigns, events, networking, past clients, and other sources.

• Track the movement from lead to scheduled consultation, consultation completed, retained client, and revenue collected.

• Track referral sources and report which referral sources are sending leads and which are converting.

• Track website, SEO, PPC, social media,
 campaign, newsletter, and event performance.

• Track cost per lead, cost per consult, cost per retained client, and estimated return on investment.

• Maintain current client/prospect/lead statistics and report weekly to the Owner.

• Report on new prospects, leads, consults, proposals, retained clients, campaign trends, and follow-up status.

• Review marketing and sales “glidepath” metrics weekly or monthly.

• Identify what is working, what is not working, and what should be adjusted.

The job involves tracking prospective clients, referral sources, leads, client/prospect statistics, campaign performance, and marketing metrics to support data-driven decisions.



3. Content Creation and Distribution

The Marketing Specialist will help create and distribute content that builds trust, educates prospective clients, and reinforces the firm’s reputation as a tax controversy and IRS defense firm.  Responsibilities include:

• Draft, edit, proofread, and coordinate content for blog posts, newsletters,
 campaigns, social media posts, website updates, client alerts, and short-form video scripts.

• Collaborate with the Owner and attorneys to turn frequently asked client questions into marketing content.

• Maintain an editorial calendar.

• Ensure content is accurate, professional, clear, and consistent with the firm’s voice.

• Repurpose content across multiple channels when appropriate.

• Coordinate with outside writers, designers, or vendors when needed.

Core responsibilities include content creation for blog posts, newsletters, articles, and social media, along with collaboration with attorneys and staff.



4. Website, Social Media, and Digital Marketing

The Marketing Specialist will help maintain the firm’s online presence and coordinate digital marketing efforts.  Responsibilities include:

• Keep the firm’s website content current and accurate.

• Coordinate website edits with the website vendor or make approved updates directly through WordPress or another content management system.

• Manage or assist with LinkedIn,
, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and other approved platforms.

• Schedule approved social media posts.

• Monitor comments, reviews, messages, and reputation-related issues.

• Assist with SEO, directory listings, PPC, and digital advertising coordination.

• Track digital marketing metrics and make recommendations based on performance.

The core responsibilities include website updates, social media, YouTube, directory listings, PPC, reputation management, and web analytics.



5. Referral Source and Relationship Marketing

The Marketing Specialist will support the firm’s referral marketing systems and help maintain strong relationships with referral sources, former clients, and professional contacts.  Responsibilities include:

• Maintain and update referral source lists.

• Track referral source activity and results.

• Help schedule lunches, coffees, calls, and follow-up meetings with referral sources.

• Prepare materials for referral source meetings.

• Send thank-you notes, cards, newsletters, gifts, and follow-up communications.

• Assist with “Team 100” or similar relationship marketing systems.

• Support post-case follow-up systems to nurture past clients and referral relationships.

• Identify new potential referral sources and target-rich environments for the firm.

The core responsibilities include referral source research, scheduling referral meetings, Team 100, post-case follow-up, gifts, newsletters, and relationship-nurturing systems.



6.
 Marketing, Newsletters, and Client Communication

Responsibilities include:

• Coordinate weekly or monthly
 marketing.

• Help prepare newsletters and client updates.

• Maintain
 lists and segment contacts as appropriate.

• Track
 open rates, click rates, unsubscribes, replies, and resulting consultations or leads.

• Ensure communications are timely, professional, and consistent with the firm’s brand.

• Assist with client surveys and feedback programs.

• Maintain professional communication with clients, former clients, prospects, referral sources, and vendors.

The core responsibilities include newsletters, weekly
 marketing pieces, client communication, client surveys, and maintaining a consistent brand image.



7. Event, Webinar, and Seminar Support

Responsibilities include:

• Identify possible speaking opportunities, webinars, seminars, podcasts, networking events, and community education opportunities.

• Coordinate event logistics, invitations, registration, attendance tracking, materials, and follow-up.

• Prepare attorneys for events with materials, schedules, talking points, and follow-up lists.

• Track event results, including leads generated, consults scheduled, retained clients, revenue, and cost per result.

• Provide post-event reports and recommendations.

The core responsibilities include identifying organizations willing to invite attorneys to speak, arranging seminars, coordinating event logistics, managing registrations, and tracking post-event follow-up.



Weekly Reporting Responsibilities

Each week, the Marketing Specialist should provide a concise report to the Owner that includes:

• New leads by source.

• Consultations scheduled.

• Consultations completed.

• New clients retained.

• Revenue attributed to marketing sources, where trackable.

• Referral sources who sent leads.

• Campaigns launched or completed.

• Website, SEO, PPC,
, and social media highlights.

• Follow-up items overdue or needing attorney input.

• Recommendations for what to continue, stop, or improve.



Qualifications

Preferred qualifications include:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or related field preferred, but not required if the candidate has strong experience.

• One to three years of experience in marketing, professional services, law firm marketing, client intake, sales support, or related work.

• Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Comfortable working with attorneys, clients, referral sources, vendors, and tea
mbers.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel or Google Sheets, CRM systems,
 marketing software, and social media platforms.

• Familiarity with WordPress, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, SEO, PPC, Canva, Adobe, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Lawmatics, or similar tools is a plus.

• Ability to interpret marketing data and turn it into practical recommendations.

• Ability to work independently, follow procedures, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects.

• Positive, professional, no-drama personality.

• Willingness to learn tax controversy marketing and the firm’s voice.



Personal Characteristics

The ideal candidate is:

• Organized.

• Accurate.

• Curious.

• Comfortable with numbers and analytics.

• A good writer.

• A good follow-up person.

• Calm under deadlines.

• Able to manage details without losing sight of the larger goal.

• Comfortable asking for what they need from the Owner or attorneys.

• Willing to suggest improvements.

• Focused on measurable results, not just activity.



Success in This Role

The Marketing Specialist will be successful if the firm has a consistent, organized marketing system; the Owner knows where leads are coming from; referral relationships are nurtured; marketing deadlines are met; campaigns are tracked; and the firm can make better decisions because marketing data is accurate, current, and reviewed regularly.

title: Creative Producer / Video Quality Control — Facebook Ad Videos (Part-Time, Long-Term, Remote)
description:
ABOUT US

We are a European e-commerce brand selling in 10 markets. We run
 and

Instagram video ads at high volume. A team of freelance video editors delivers

our ads to us every week. Right now the owner reviews every single video

himself. That is the job we are handing to you.

WHAT THIS JOB IS

You are the gate. Nothing reaches the owner until you have approved it.

Our editors deliver in "cards". One card = one script = three videos (Hook A,

Hook B, Hook C — same body, three different openings). We receive between 15

and 60 cards per week depending on the season.

Your job is to open every single video, watch it fully, check it against our

internal quality checklist, and d
: approved, or sent back with notes.

You are not judging whether the ad is creative or whether it will sell. That is

not your call and never will be. You are checking that the delivery is

technically correct and complete. It is detail work. It rewards patience.

A TYPICAL DAY

- You open our delivery board and see which cards came in since yesterday.

- You open each Google Drive folder and watch all three videos, start to finish.

- You go through the checklist for each one and write down what fails.

- Approved cards get marked and moved forward.

- Failed cards go back to the editor with clear written notes: what is wrong,

  where in the video, and what you need instead. Never "please fix" — always

  the exact timestamp and the exact problem.

- (Read this line carefully, because most applicants will not: begin your Loom

  video by saying the words FROZEN FRAME out loud, before you say your name.)

- You chase editors who are late.

- At the end of your day you post one short report: what came in, what you

  approved, what you rejected and why, what is overdue.

THE CHECKLIST

You will get our full checklist on your first day and you will work from it

every single day. It is written, it is specific, and it is not negotiable. We

do not share it before hiring. What we can tell you is that it covers hooks,

subtitles, audio, timing, file delivery and the ending of the video — and that

it catches things most people would scroll straight past.

WHAT WE REQUIRE

- You are slow and careful. We would rather wait one day than receive one bad

  video. Speed is not what we are paying for.

- You read instructions completely, the first time.

- When you are told something once, it does not happen again. We do not want

  to repeat a correction.

- You can tell an editor their work is not good enough, in writing, politely,

  and without avoiding it.

- You have watched or worked with short-form video ads before and you know

  what a hook is.

- You are reliable Monday to Friday at a fixed daily check-in time.

- Stable internet good enough to stream and scrub video, and a computer that

  can play 1080p smoothly.

- Working written English.

WHAT WE DO NOT REQUIRE

- You do not need to edit video. You will never open an editing program.

- You do not need to write scripts, come up with ideas, or run ads.

- You do not need marketing experience.

TERMS

- 10- 20 hours per week to start, growing as our volume grows.

- 8 USD per hour.

- 30-day paid trial, then long-term. We are looking for someone who stays

  for years, not months.

- Tools: Notion, Google Drive, WhatsApp.

- Paid test task before we d
. Real videos. We pay for your time either

  way, whether or not we hire you.

HOW TO APPLY

Send us a Loom video, recorded for this job only. Two to three minutes.

In it:

1. Introduce yourself.

2. Tell us why you fit this specific job.

3. Go find any
 or Instagram video ad, watch it, and tell us one thing

   you think was done badly and one thing you think was done well. Show us the

   ad on your screen while you talk about it.

Recycled Looms are obvious to us and we stop watching them. We want to hear you

talk about this job, not about your career in general.

title: Back-End Operations Manager - E-Commerce

About Us

If you love building systems, solving problems, and taking ownership, this could become a long-term career with significant growth opportunities.



Your Responsibilities

1. Customer Support Management



You will oversee our customer support team on a daily basis.



Your responsibilities include:



Monitor customer support inbox.

Ensure all
s are answered within our required response times.

Review the oldest unanswered
s.

Ensure no inbox is being ignored.

Review random customer conversations every day.

Verify that agents follow our SOPs.

Ensure agents read the entire
 thread before replying.

Identify incorrect refunds, reshipments, promises, or policy violations.

Give clear feedback when mistakes are found.

Document employee mistakes.

Follow up to ensure mistakes are corrected.

Escalate repeated performance issues when necessary.

IMPORTANT



To confirm that you have carefully read this entire job description, please start your application with the words:



BACK-END OPERATIONS



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



Continue reading carefully—there is more important information below.



2. Chargebacks & Payment Disputes



You will monitor all payment disputes across platforms such as:



Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Other payment providers



Your responsibilities include:



Check for new disputes every day.

Log every dispute immediately.

Record all deadlines.

Assign cases when required.

Review chargeback evidence before submission.

Verify tracking information.

Verify customer communication.

Verify policies and supporting documentation.

Ensure every dispute is submitted before the deadline.

Track dispute outcomes.

Document why disputes are won or lost.

Identify repeated dispute patterns.

Suggest improvements to reduce future chargebacks.



No dispute should ever be lost because of a missed deadline or poor preparation.



3. Inventory Management



You will monitor inventory and help ensure we never unexpectedly run out of stock & communicate directly with the agent keeping track of quality issues, shipping issues etc & how to resolve them!



Responsibilities include:



Monitor inventory levels.

Track daily sales volume.

Forecast inventory requirements.

Calculate estimated days of stock remaining.

Monitor incoming inventory shipments.

Track supplier lead times.

Identify stock risks before they become urgent.

Recommend reorder quantities.

Inform management when inventory action is required.

Track ?iled deliveries & Why.

Track & Broken/faulty products & Why & how to prevent it from happening.

4. Refund & Reshipment Review



You will review operational decisions involving:



Full refunds

Partial refunds

Reshipments

Order cancellations

Customer compensation



Your job is to verify that every decision follows company policy.



5. Fulfillment Monitoring



Monitor operational fulfillment including:



Unfulfilled orders

Missing tracking numbers

Delayed shipments

Returned packages

Packages awaiting customer pickup

Incorrect shipments

Country-specific shipping issues



Every issue should have an owner, action plan, and follow-up.



6. Process Improvement



One of your most important responsibilities is improving our systems.



Whenever the same mistake happens more than once, you should:



Find the root cause.

Determine whether an SOP already exists.

Improve the SOP if necessary.

Train the team.

Verify that the mistake does not happen again.



We don't like solving the same problems twice.



7. Daily Operations Report



Every working day you will provide a concise report covering:



Customer support status

Employee performance

Chargebacks

Inventory

Fulfillment

Refunds

Reshipments

Critical operational issues

Decisions requiring management approval



Your reports should be clear, organized, and accurate.



What We Are Looking For

Previous experience in e-commerce operations, customer support management, operations, or project management.

Strong attention to detail.

Excellent written English.

Strong problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently.

Shopify

Excel

Whats app

USD/month

depending on experience.
