title: VIRTUAL OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
# Full-Time Virtual Operations Manager (Work From Home)



### Company: Revolution Relocation



**Location:** Remote (Philippines)



**Employment Type:** Full-Time



**Hours:** 40+ hours per week (U.S. Mountain Time)



## About Us



Revolution Relocation is a fast-growing interstate moving company based in Arizona, USA. We specialize in long-distance household relocations across the United States and are committed to delivering exceptional customer service from booking through final delivery.



We're looking for a highly organized, proactive, and dependable **Virtual Operations Manager** to become a key leader within our company. This is a long-term career opportunity for someone who wants to grow with a rapidly expanding business.



---



## About the Position



As our Virtual Operations Manager, you will oversee the daily operations of the company and ensure every department works together efficiently. You will help coordinate office staff, dispatch, customer service, scheduling, drivers, and customer communication while maintaining a high level of organization and professionalism.



This position requires someone who can think ahead, solve problems independently, and confidently manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.



---



## Primary Responsibilities



* Oversee daily office operations and workflow

* Coordinate dispatch, scheduling, pickups, and deliveries

* Manage customer service representatives and office staff

* Communicate with customers regarding their moves and resolve escalated concerns

* Work directly with drivers, foremen, and field crews

* Ensure jobs remain on schedule and proactively resolve operational issues

* Monitor calendars, schedules, and delivery timelines

* Improve company systems and operating procedures

* Maintain accurate records and documentation

* Assist with claims, storage coordination, and administrative tasks

* Help train new office employees

* Track performance and ensure high customer satisfaction

* Report directly to company ownership with updates and recommendations



---



## We're Looking For Someone Who



* Is an exceptional multitasker

* Has outstanding organizational skills

* Takes ownership and solves problems without waiting to be told

* Thinks critically and makes sound decisions

* Works well under pressure

* Is dependable, reliable, and highly organized

* Has excellent leadership and communication skills

* Enjoys helping customers and supporting a team

* Learns new software quickly

* Has a strong attention to detail

* Is eager to learn and grow with the company

* Wants a long-term career, not just another remote job



---



## English Requirement (Required)



**Excellent English communication is a MUST.**



Because you will be communicating directly with customers, employees, and company leadership throughout the United States, you must have **fluent, professional English** with clear pronunciation, excellent grammar, and outstanding written communication skills.



You must be comfortable leading phone conversations, writing professional
s, handling customer concerns, and representing Revolution Relocation with confidence and professionalism.



Applicants with weak English communication skills will not be considered.



---



## Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly preferred:



* Operations Management

* Logistics

* Transportation

* Dispatch

* Customer Service Management

* Household Goods Moving

* Interstate Moving Industry

* Office Management

* Team Leadership

* Project Management



**Previous experience working for an interstate moving company is a HUGE advantage, but we are willing to train an exceptional candidate with strong leadership skills.**



---



## Computer Requirements



You must have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* Quiet home office

* Computer capable of handling multiple applications simultaneously

* Quality headset with microphone

* Backup internet or power solution is preferred



---



## Work Schedule



* Full-Time

* Monday–Friday (some flexibility may be required during peak moving season)

* Must be available during U.S. Mountain Time business hours



---



## Compensation



Competitive salary based on experience.



Performance bonuses, raises, and advancement opportunities are available for individuals who consistently perform at a high level and help improve company operations.



---



## Why Join Revolution Relocation?



* Long-term career opportunity

* Stable full-time employment

* Direct communication with company ownership

* Opportunity to help build and improve company systems

* Leadership role with room for advancement

* Supportive team environment

* Performance-based bonuses

* Be part of a fast-growing company where your ideas and leadership will make a real impact



---



# How to Apply



To help us identify candidates who pay close attention to detail, please follow these instructions carefully.



1. Submit your resume.

2. Include a brief introduction about yourself.

3. Tell us about your leadership and operations experience.

4. Record a **2–3 minute video** introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a great Operations Manager for Revolution Relocation.

5. Describe a difficult operational problem you solved in a previous role and the outcome.

6. In the **first line** of your application, include the phrase:



**"Organization creates success."**



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



We're looking for someone who wants to become an essential part of our leadership team and help build one of the best interstate moving companies in the United States. If you're organized, proactive, and passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Client Care & Inside Sales Coordinator — $6/Hour + Benefits and Performance Incentives
description:
Long-Term Growth Opportunity to Become Office Manager

Note: Cover Letter and Voice Recording Required to Apply.

Do you love providing excellent service in a support-based role?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing a variety of tasks? Do you love talking to customers and providing excellent customer service? Keep reading!

About Boulder Pro Painters

Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an amazing customer experience.

We are a very entrepreneurial company, and we believe strongly in taking care of our customers and our amazing tea
mbers by providing a great work environment and career growth opportunities.

We value integrity, responsibility, and life balance. We believe work should empower your life, not take away from it. You should love where you work, be treated well, be part of a great team, and have opportunities to grow in your career.

Our growth and success depend on the culture we are creating. Our team is made up of ambitious and dependable people, with a heavy focus on personal growth and professional development to ensure our tea
mbers achieve their goals and all they are capable of while producing great results for the company, our customers, and our team.

In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help me manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow-up, and the day-to-day organization of the business.

This is an important, long-term role with the opportunity to learn the business, take ownership of your responsibilities, increase your hours, and grow into our Office Manager as the company continues to grow.

Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing

We’re committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service for our customers. We want our customers talking about what an amazing experience they had working with Boulder Pro Painters. We want customers for life.

This role is a large part of that. Here are a few things you’ll be doing regularly:

* Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly.

* Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate.

* Asking qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations.

* Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them.

* Managing estimate appointments in my calendar.

* Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests.

* Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment.

* Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision.

* Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow-up activities.

* Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized.

* Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications.

* Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the day-to-day organization of the business.

As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability, you will take on additional responsibilities, including:

* Reconnecting with old leads and past customers.

* Requesting customer reviews and referrals.

* Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other referral partners.

* Supporting customers after their project is approved.

* Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps.

* Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information.

* Helping improve our scripts, processes, and systems.

* Preparing simple lead, estimate, and follow-up reports.

* Taking ownership of additional office-management responsibilities.

Who We Are Looking For — About You

* You thrive in a fast-paced work environment.

* You love being in a support role, and you love making other people’s lives easier.

* You enjoy talking with customers, and you get satisfaction from providing customers with an amazing experience each and every time you interact with them.

* You are a natural communicator, and you’re very comfortable talking on the phone.

* You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States.

* People say you have great energy—you’re a positive, optimistic person.

* You’re a go-getter. You don’t need to be told what to do at every step.

* You are proactive and always looking for what else you can provide to the business and the team.

* You are highly organized and pay close attention to details.

* You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders.

* You take ownership when something needs to be completed.

* You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation.

* You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations.

* You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, and follow-ups without losing track of important details.

* You are comfortable receiving feedback, practicing calls, and continuously improving.

* You want a stable, long-term position where you can grow with the company.

* You are available to transition into a full-time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase.

* You have reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.

* You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, or supporting a US-based company is preferred.

Experience with a home-service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, or scheduling software is helpful but not required. We are willing to train the right person who has the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

Compensation & Job Details

* This is a remote, long-term position for candidates located in the Philippines.

* The position will begin with a paid 30-day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week.

* Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. Mountain Time.

* The position is intended to increase to 30–40 hours per week within approximately 30–60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred.

* Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full-time.

* Full-time working hours will be Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one-hour unpaid meal break.

* Colorado observes daylight-saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year.

* Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour.

* You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate that is scheduled and completed.

* A qualified estimate must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines.

* You’ll be paid twice per month.

* Paid training is included.

* Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days.

* Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90-day review.

* You will receive prorated 13th-month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year.

* Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the 90-day introductory period.

* Additional performance incentives, raises, and promotions are available to top performers.

* This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow.

This is more than a short-term virtual-assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, understand how the company operates, and take on greater responsibility over time.

Our business is growing, and we’re looking to hire someone within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit.

Does this job sound like a good fit for you? Do you sound like the kind of person we are looking for?

We’d love to hear from you.

To Apply, Please Include the Following Information

* Tell us why you are interested in this position and why you think you are the person we are looking for.

* Attach your résumé.

* Include a one-to-two-minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your customer-service, inside-sales, or administrative experience.

* Confirm that you can work the initial part-time schedule and transition into the required full-time Mountain Time schedule.

* Provide your availability in both Philippine Time and Mountain Time.

* Describe your internet connection and your backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

* Tell us whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers.

* Briefly explain how you would handle a homeowner who requested an estimate but did not answer your first call.

Applications that do not include a cover letter, résumé, and voice recording will not be considered.



Best,

Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO

Boulder Pro Painters

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Sunday - Friday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 10 AM - 8 PM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

title: Ecommerce Operator, US Fashion Brand. Up to $2,500/mo. Not a VA Role.
description:
Read this entire post before applying. Most applications are rejected in under sixty seconds.



We are a US women's fashion brand headquartered in Los Angeles. We run our own warehouse, launch 30 new products every two weeks, and move real volume. The owner runs 30+ employees across multiple companies. This seat reports into our LA management team and sits with the owner every single week.



We are filling one position:



[Data Analytics Specialist / Merchandising Specialist / Website and UX Coordinator]



Who we are actually looking for



You have held a real position at a real company. You have owned a function, not a queue of tasks. You have sat in rooms where decisions were made and you were expected to arrive with a point of view.



You are exceptionally analytical. You do not look at a dashboard and describe it. You look at it and find the thing nobody else noticed, then you build the case for what to do about it. You know the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters. You can take a messy export, find the story inside it, and explain that story to a non-technical person in one paragraph.



You know Shopify end to end. Not the basics. Everything. Collections and automated collection rules, tags, metafields, variants and inventory logic, Search and Discovery, filtering, analytics and custom reports, discounts and price rules, theme sections and templates, apps and where they break, checkout behaviour, and how all of it connects. If your Shopify experience is "I've uploaded products," this is not your role.



You manage yourself, completely. Nobody will build your day for you. You will not be handed a list of ideas to execute. You are expected to generate the ideas, prioritise them yourself, and defend why you chose one over another. If you finish everything by 2pm, you go find the next problem. That single trait matters more to us than anything on your CV.



You will lead. You are one of three specialists who run this department together, and you are expected to lead within it, hold the other two to the standard, and grow into managing people directly as we scale. We promote from this seat. We do not hire above it.



You are relentless about time. You push the limit of what can be done in a working day, every day. You are not busy, you are productive, and you know the difference. Slow weeks are visible here and they are not tolerated for long.



You have real interpersonal skill. You work daily with our LA marketing manager, inventory manager, designer,
 and social leads, and the owner. You can disagree with someone senior, make your case cleanly, and then commit to whatever gets d
. You bring problems early, not late. You are the person others want on the call.



You write and speak English at a native US standard. Not "good English." American level. Ideally you have lived, studied or worked in the United States, or spent years working directly with American executives, and it shows in how you write. We will know within two sentences.



Results, plainly



You will own a specific set of numbers. Conversion, average order value, sell through, revenue per visitor, depending on the seat. Every Friday you report what you changed and what it moved. Every month we look at whether the business actually improved.



This is a high accountability seat with real upside. People who move the numbers grow quickly here and are paid accordingly. People who cannot, do not stay. We are direct about this on day one so nobody is surprised at day 90.



Do not apply if



Your background is customer service, chat support, appointment setting, cold calling, lead generation, or general VA work

You need a script, a checklist, or daily instructions to be productive

You have never owned a number a business cared about

You want part time, or plan to run this alongside other clients

You are applying to more than three jobs today



The details



Full time, 40 hours per week, single client, long term

9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Los Angeles time. Roughly midnight to 8:00 AM Manila. Do not apply unless that is genuinely sustainable for you

Reachable and ready to join a call at short notice throughout those hours, camera on

Two short team stand ups daily, plus two meetings a week with LA management and ownership

Reports to our Marketing Manager and Inventory Manager. Weekly with the owner

Up to $2,500 per month, based on what you actually bring. Reviewed at 90 days

Clear path into a leadership seat as the department grows



How to apply



Applications that skip any step are deleted unread.



Begin your message with the word CALIBER

In three sentences: the most important decision you made in a previous role, and what happened as a result

The number you were responsible for in your last job, and whether you moved it

Answer honestly: if you finished all your assigned work by 2pm, what would you do with the rest of the day?

Rate your Shopify knowledge one to ten and justify the number with something specific you have built or fixed

Your internet setup, and your backup when the power or connection drops

A 90 second Loom or unlisted YouTube video introducing yourself. No script. We are listening to how you think and how you speak



No generic cover letters. No unrelated portfolios. Answer the seven items and nothing else.



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid test task on our real data, then interview on video with our LA team and the owner.

description:
About us

We're a small team. The owners are currently the escalation point for everything, and we're hiring you so that stops being true.

This is a working role, not a pure management role.



About half your week is overseeing a small team. The other half is doing real work yourself — the kind that takes judgment and can't be handed to a rep: chargebacks, freight paperwork, carrier claims, marketplace issues, escalations.



If you're looking for a role where you only manage and delegate, this isn't it. We want someone who's good at both and doesn't consider hands-on work beneath them.

Address problems the same week you see them, not the next month

Run daily check-ins and weekly one-on-ones

Own scheduling and coverage, including who covers when someone is out

Onboard and train new hires against our written procedures

Cross-train the team so no task has only one person who can do it

Run quality reviews on customer
s, chats, and calls, and coach on what you find

Document performance problems in writing, on time, following our process

Interview candidates when we're hiring

Recommend when someone isn't working out — the final call is ours, but we'll rely on your read

Building how we work

Design workflows for work that currently has none

Keep our written procedures current. When something changes, the document changes

Find recurring problems and fix the cause, not the symptom

Look for what's falling through the cracks and close the gap before we notice it

Hands-on work (about half your time)

Chargebacks and payment disputes — filing, evidence, follow-through

BOLs and freight paperwork, inbound and outbound

Carrier claims and delivery failures — the ones a rep can't resolve

Vendor and contractor invoice review — verifying what we're billed matches what was delivered

Amazon and marketplace issues that need real problem solving

Customer escalations the team can't close

Whatever else needs a brain rather than a script

Reporting

Weekly report to ownership: what moved, what didn't, what needs a decision from us

Bring us decisions, not status updates

What we're looking for



Required



2+ years managing or supervising people, with real responsibility for their performance

You've had the hard conversation. You've told someone their work wasn't good enough and documented it

Comfortable with numbers — you can read a report, spot what's wrong, and act

E-commerce operations experience (Shopify or similar)

Works US Eastern hours, Monday–Friday

No other job or client commitments



Strongly preferred



Chargeback or payment dispute experience

Freight, BOLs, carrier claims, or 3PL exposure

Amazon Seller Central

Property management, self-storage, or leasing experience

Experience writing procedures or building workflows from scratch

Experience interviewing or onboarding remote staff



Not a fit if



You want a role where you only delegate and report

You consider hands-on work below your level

You need someone above you to make routine calls

You've only managed by being liked

What we offer

Competitive rate based on experience

Real ownership. You'll shape how this operation runs, not just execute someone else's plan

A small, established, profitable company with 25+ years of history

Direct access to the owners. No layers, no politics

Written procedures for most of what we do — and where they don't exist, you'll write them

Long-term, stable position



Hours: 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, US Eastern time.



Please note: we use time-tracking software across the entire remote team, including this role. We measure results, but activity is tracked and we're upfront about it.



To apply



Answer these in your application. Applications without answers won't be read. Write your own answers — please don't use AI.

title: Instagram Outreach + Closer — Commission Only, Uncapped ($189+ Per Sale, Music Marketing)
description:
Maxx Volume is a U.S.-based music marketing company. We help independent artists grow real fanbases through advertising and strategy — no bots, no playlist farms, no fake streams.



We are looking for ONE person to find qualified independent artists on Instagram, open conversations, and close them into our program.



READ THIS FIRST: This is a COMMISSION-ONLY role. There is no base salary and no hourly pay. You earn 5% of every sale you close, on a minimum package of $3,788 — that's $189 per close, uncapped, plus volume bonuses on top.



If you want guaranteed monthly pay, this is not the role and you should not apply. If you're confident in your ability to sell and you want your income tied to your results instead of your hours, keep reading.



------------------------------

WHAT YOU'LL DO

---------------------
. Research and add qualified artist leads to our Google Sheet.

2. Send personalized first-touch DMs from our Instagram account (script provided — you personalize each one).

3. Work the conversation, handle questions, and build enough trust to book a call.

4. Close the sale using our proven script. We give you the full script, the case studies, the objection handling, and training on all of it.

5. Track everything in the sheet and report your numbers.



You do NOT need to know the music industry. You DO need to be sharp, observant, able to tell a serious artist from a hobbyist, and genuinely comfortable asking for money. We train you on everything else.



------------------------------

WHAT A QUALIFIED LEAD LOOKS LIKE

------------------------------

We sell a premium 90-day program, so we only want artists who could realistically afford it and are already investing in themselves.



GREEN LIGHTS:

- Released music recently or clearly preparing a release

- Already spending money on their career: music videos, professional cover art, studio sessions, real photography, PR, playlist promotion, ads, or a manager/team

- Posts consistently on Instagram or TikTok

- Music and visuals are already at a decent level (marketing can actually help them)

- Some traction: roughly 1,000 to 100,000 Spotify monthly listeners, songs with 10K+ streams, solid video views, real engagement, shows, features, or press

- Talks about their music like a business and a career



RED FLAGS — DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME:

- No music released, or nothing released in a year or more

- Poor quality music or amateur visuals

- No sign they've spent a dollar on their career

- A few random posts, clearly a hobby

- Constantly asking people for free promo

- Bio says "DM for collabs" but nothing professional is happening

- Fake followers or obviously fake engagement (huge follower count, dead comments)



Since you're paid on closes, lead quality is your income. Chasing broke hobbyists costs you money, not just time. QUALITY OVER QUANTITY, every time.



------------------------------

WHERE TO FIND THEM

------------------------------

- Instagram: artist pages, producer pages, recording studios, music photographers and videographers, music video directors, music marketing pages, and the artists those accounts tag

- Comment sections under music industry pages

- TikTok: indie artists promoting songs, artists with strong video views but weak streaming numbers, artists asking about Spotify growth or promotion

- Spotify: artists on independent playlists in our genres

- YouTube: professional-looking music videos with low view counts

- Music blogs, show flyers, and local event lineups



Studios, producers, engineers, and photographers are the best hunting grounds. If an artist is tagged at a studio or working with a paid photographer, they are already spending money — that's a strong buying signal, and a strong buying signal is your paycheck.



------------------------------

WHAT GOES IN THE SHEET FOR EVERY LEAD

------------------------------

- 
 Spotify link

- Spotify monthly listeners

- Instagram follower count

- Best performing song

- Last release date

- Why they look qualified (1-2 sentences)

- The obvious problem we could solve for them (1 sentence)



If you can't fill in the last two lines with something real, it is not a lead.



------------------------------

WHAT WE ARE NOT

------------------------------

This is not spam. We do not copy-paste the same message 200 times a day. Every DM references something specific about that artist — their new single, their video, their numbers. Volume matters less than the quality of the conversation. Lazy generic messages don't close, and closing is how you get paid.



------------------------------

HOW YOU GET PAID

------------------------------

BASE COMMISSION: 5% of every closed sale.

Minimum package is $3,788, so that's $189 minimum per close. Larger packages pay more.



VOLUME BONUS — your rate goes UP as you close more in a calendar month:

- 1-2 closes/month .......... 5%    (~$189 each)

- 3-4 closes/month .......... 7%    (~$265 each)

- 5-7 closes/month .......... 8%    (~$303 each)

- 8+ closes/month ........... 10%   (~$379 each)



The higher rate applies to EVERY sale that month, not just the ones above the threshold. Hit 8 closes in a month at the minimum package and you've earned over $3,000 — from one month of work, with no cap.



Commission is paid after the client's payment clears. Paid weekly or twice monthly, your preference, via your preferred method.



If you consistently produce, we will talk about a base salary on top of commission. But you have to prove it first.



------------------------------

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

------------------------------

- Sales experience — appointment setting, closing, high-ticket, or similar. Tell us what you sold and what you closed.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be messaging and speaking with U.S.-based artists.

- Comfortable on Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, and YouTube

- Strong research instincts — you enjoy digging and connecting dots

- Organized with Google Sheets

- Self-motivated. Nobody is going to monitor your hours. Your results are the only thing measured.

- Stable internet and a computer (this is not phone-only work)

- Bonus: you like music, follow artists, or have run social accounts before



------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

------------------------------

Applications that skip these steps get deleted. This is the filter.



1. Start your message with the word "VOLUME" so I know you read the whole post.



2. Answer these questions:

   a) What have you sold before, at what price point, and what were your actual numbers?

   b) Are you genuinely comfortable working commission-only? Be honest — I'd rather know now.

   c) How many hours per week can you commit, and what are your working hours in EST?

   d) What is one specific thing you would look at on an artist's Instagram to tell whether they are spending real money on their career?



3. Do this short sample task — this is what actually gets you hired:

   Go find ONE real independent artist on Instagram who fits the criteria above. Send me:

   - Their 
 Their Spotify monthly listeners

   - Their last release date

   - Two sentences on why you think they're qualified

   - One sentence on the problem we could solve for them

The Human Handoff: Build a trigger that alerts our human operations manager (via
 or SMS) if a customer says "I want to buy," asks for a custom quote, or asks a complex question the AI cannot answer.



Requirements:



Proven experience building complex workflows in Zapier or 
.



Direct experience integrating OpenAI APIs into
 systems and training the AI on custom data.



Strong understanding of
 marketing platforms (Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, GoHighLevel, etc.) and conditional logic/routing.



Excellent written English (to review and fine-tune the AI's
 prompts).

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer
description:
# Senior Meta Ads Media Buyer — DTC Scaling + High-Volume Creative Testing



We are hiring an experienced **Senior Meta Ads Media Buyer** to help aggressively scale a fast-growing ecommerce brand.



We are not looking for someone whose primary job is maintaining the account.



We want someone who knows how to **scale Meta spend, test creative at high volume, identify winners quickly, and turn a massive creator ecosystem into profitable growth.**



## Our Situation



* Approximately **$2,500/day in Meta spend today**

* Ecommerce / DTC brand

* Large creator ecosystem

* Approximately **100 new creator/UGC videos coming in every week**

* Purchase-focused advertising

* Strong creative production engine already in place

* Our goal is to **scale significantly**



Creative volume is NOT our bottleneck.



Our challenge is building the media-buying infrastructure that can properly test, analyze, scale, and rotate this amount of creative.



## The Opportunity



Imagine receiving **100 new videos every single week**.



Your job is to build a system that answers:



Which videos get tested?



How quickly can we test them?



How much spend does each test need?



How do we identify winners without wasting massive amounts of budget?



How do we scale winning creatives aggressively?



How do we continue feeding new creative into Meta without disturbing campaigns that are already performing?



How do we prevent hundreds of dead or irrelevant ads from accumulating?



How do we use creative performance data to tell our creator team what to produce next?



And most importantly:



**How do we scale from our current spend level to significantly higher spend while maintaining acceptable profitability?**



## What You'll Own



You will own the Meta media-buying strategy.



Responsibilities include:



* Manage and scale approximately $2,500+/day in Meta spend

* Build a scalable creative-testing infrastructure capable of handling **100+ new videos per week**

* D
 how creative should enter the account

* Determine appropriate testing budgets and testing methodology

* Rapidly identify winning creators, hooks, concepts, angles, offers, and formats

* Scale winning ads and campaigns

* Protect established profitable campaigns from unnecessary changes

* Build clear systems for:



  * Testing

  * Graduation

  * Scaling

  * Creative retirement

  * Creative rotation

* Increase spend when performance supports it

* Identify opportunities to scale horizontally and vertically

* Maintain clean campaign architecture as creative volume grows

* Prevent unnecessary account and ad-volume bloat

* Analyze creative performance at a deeper level than just individual-ad ROAS

* Communicate winning creative patterns back to our creator and creative teams

* Help determine what the next 100 videos should look like based on performance data



## We Are NOT Looking for a Conservative Account Manager



We are looking for a **growth-minded media buyer**.



We do not want someone whose entire strategy is:



"Pause bad ads."



"Don't touch anything."



"Reduce the number of campaigns."



"Maintain current ROAS."



We want someone who understands when to protect winners — but also knows how to **push an account forward aggressively and intelligently**.



The goal is not simply to make the account cleaner.



The goal is to create an account structure that allows us to:



**TEST MORE ? FIND MORE WINNERS ? SCALE MORE ? SPEND MORE PROFITABLY.**



## The Person We're Looking For



You should have significant hands-on experience scaling DTC/ecommerce brands on Meta.



Ideally, you have personally managed accounts spending at least:



**$100,000+/month**



Preference will be given to candidates who have successfully scaled accounts materially beyond that level.



We especially want experience with brands where **creative volume is very high**.



You should understand:



* High-volume creative testing

* Meta campaign architecture

* Scaling profitable campaigns

* CBO / ABO

* Advantage+ Sales campaigns

* Broad targeting

* Creative fatigue

* Creative iteration

* Hook and concept analysis

* UGC / creator advertising

* Partnership ads / creator ads

* Budget scaling

* Audience and account consolidation

* Meta learning and delivery

* Attribution

* Pixel + Conversions API

* CPA / CAC

* ROAS / MER

* Incremental spend decisions

* Creative testing economics



We want someone who can answer:



**"If I give you another $10,000 of spend, where would you put it and why?"**



## Our Previous Problem



Historically, we were adding large numbers of new creatives into many campaigns every few days.



Some of those campaigns were already profitable.



We did not have a clearly defined testing environment, graduation system, or creative retirement process.



As a result, the account accumulated a very large number of active ads.



We are fixing that.



But we do NOT want to solve the problem by simply testing less.



We want to **test even more creative — just with a much better system.**



## Application Challenge



This question is the most important part of your application.



Assume the following:



* Current Meta spend: **$2,500/day**

* Ecommerce brand

* Approximately **100 new creator videos every week**

* Goal: aggressively scale spend while maintaining profitable acquisition

* Strong existing campaigns already generating purchases

* Historically too many new creatives were inserted into existing winning campaigns



Design the Meta Ads system you would use.



Please explain:



1. How would you process **100 new videos every week**?



2. Would you test all 100? If not, how would you d
 what gets tested?



3. How many testing campaigns or ad sets would you use?



4. Would you use ABO, CBO, Advantage+ Sales, or another structure? Why?



5. How much budget would you allocate to testing?



6. How much spend does a creative need before you make a decision?



7. How do you prevent Meta from giving all the spend to one early winner and starving the other tests?



8. What determines whether an ad is:



   * Killed

   * Given more time

   * Declared a winner



9. Once you find a winner, what exactly happens next?



10. Do you duplicate it into another campaign, leave it where it is, or both?



11. What happens if the entire testing campaign becomes highly profitable?



12. How do you scale from **$2,500/day ? $5,000/day ? $10,000/day+**?



13. How do you d
 when the account is ready for another budget increase?



14. How would you prevent hundreds of inactive or low-delivery ads from accumulating again?



15. What information would you send back to our creator team so the next 100 videos are better than the previous 100?



Be specific.



We are not looking for one "correct" Meta structure.



We want to understand **how you think about scaling.**



## Required With Your Application



Please include:



1. The largest Meta account you have PERSONALLY managed

2. Highest monthly spend you personally controlled

3. The starting spend and the spend level you scaled it to

4. Industry / product category

5. Approximate CPA/CAC or ROAS before and after scaling, if you are able to share

6. Whether you personally created the media-buying strategy

7. Experience managing high-volume creative testing

8. How many new creatives you were accustomed to testing per week

9. A Loom walkthrough of a Meta account you have managed, with confidential information removed

10. Your answer to the application challenge above



Please start your application with:



**"100 VIDEOS"**



Applications without this phrase will not be reviewed.



## Important



We are NOT looking for someone who has only:



* Managed small local-business campaigns

* Spent $5K–$10K/month

* Followed an agency SOP

* Uploaded ads for another strategist

* Optimized campaigns without being responsible for scaling decisions



We want someone who has actually been responsible for **growth.**



## Compensation



Competitive monthly compensation + potential performance incentives for the right person.



We care much more about finding someone who can help us scale profitably than finding the cheapest media buyer.



## Long-Term Opportunity



Our creative engine is growing rapidly.



If you can build a system that turns our creator volume into predictable profitable acquisition, there is significant room to grow with the company.



Our goal is simple:



**We want to become very good at producing creative — and exceptionally good at turning that creative into scalable Meta spend.**

title: Full-Time Executive Assistant to US Physician (Long-Term, One Employer)
description:
Hi! I'm a physician in Florida. I run a medical practice plus several small businesses, and I'm hiring ONE experienced executive assistant to work with me full-time, long-term. I'm looking for someone who wants stability and growth with a single employer for years, not project work.



A note on background: I am a physician, and much of this work touches medical administration. If you are a licensed medical doctor in the Philippines, or have clinical training, I want to know that up front. Please say so in your application. It is a strong plus for this role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

A lot of this job is follow-through. I need someone who tracks open items and chases them until they are DONE, without me reminding you.



- Managing my inboxes and my calendar

- Following up by
 with credentialing specialists and licensing companies until an application actually clears

- Reviewing my medical license spreadsheet each month and flagging what is coming up for renewal

- Scheduling my personal appointments and keeping my calendar accurate

- Travel arrangements when I need them

- Building and maintaining my social media calendar, and editing short videos in CapCut or Edits so all I have to do is post them

- Managing weekly recurring tasks so nothing lapses or auto-charges



There is also a personal side to this role that matters a lot to me. I am busy, and I want someone who will check in with my parents regularly on my behalf, keep in touch with them warmly, and help keep their appointments scheduled and on the calendar. If you are the kind of person who is good with older adults and takes that seriously, please tell me.



I will teach you everything about how I work, my systems, and my preferences. Basic CapCut or Edits editing is helpful but I am happy to train you on it. What I can't teach is attention to detail, initiative, and warmth. That part has to be you.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

- Excellent written and spoken English, including on the phone

- 2+ years of experience as an executive assistant or virtual assistant

- Extremely detail-oriented, you catch the small stuff

- Proactive, if something has been sitting for a week you are already on it before I ask

- Warm and personable, you are comfortable speaking with my family

- Trustworthy and discreet, you will handle sensitive personal information and will sign an NDA



SCHEDULE

Full-time, 40 hours per week. You must be online with me from 8:00 to 12:00 PM US Eastern time, Monday through Friday. That is 8:00 to 12:00 AM Manila time most of the year, and 9:00 to 1:00 PM Manila time from November through March. The rest of your hours are flexible, work them whenever suits you best.



I ask for a short end-of-day report every working day, answering three questions: what you did today, what you got stuck on, and what you need fro
. If you ever get stuck, I want you to come to me. I would much rather help you solve it than have you struggle alone.



PAY AND BENEFITS

- Paid weekly for your first 60 days, then biweekly, via Payoneer

- 13th month pay included

- Raises based on performance

- Paid time off after 6 months of continuous employment, just let me know in advance. Flexible about the Christmas and New Year holiday



HOW TO APPLY

1. Use at least 10 Apply Points when you send your application. I will not read applications sent with fewer.

2. Put EA-PINK7 at the end of your subject line so I know you read this carefully.

3. If you are a licensed medical doctor in the Philippines, or have clinical training, tell me in the first line of your application.



I read every application myself, and I am hiring for the long term. If this sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Seasonal Outbound Call Agent
description:
Employment Type: Seasonal Contract (via Native Teams – Employer of Record)

Contract Duration: September 28, 2026 – December 15, 2026

Compensation: PHP 40,600 per month + Performance Incentives

Schedule:

September 28 – October 31: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (US Central Time)

November 1 – December 15: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM (US Central Time)



About Marketplace Insurance Exchange



The Marketplace Insurance Exchange is committed to helping individuals and families maintain their health insurance coverage by providing exceptional service throughout the Open Enrollment period.



We're looking for three (3) Seasonal Outbound Call Agents to join our team during one of the busiest and most important times of the year.



If you enjoy helping people, communicating over the phone, and working toward measurable goals, we'd love to hear from you.





About the Role



This is not a sales position.



As a Seasonal Outbound Call Agent, your primary responsibility is to contact existing clients who have not yet completed their Open Enrollment forms and assist them in completing the required paperwork to help continue their health coverage.

You'll follow up with clients through phone calls, SMS, and WhatsApp while accurately documenting every interaction.



If a client has questions regarding insurance coverage or benefits, you'll escalate the matter to the appropriate internal team or designated insurance agent.



Key Responsibilities



- Contact existing clients with incomplete Open Enrollment forms.

- Assist clients in completing their enrollment forms during the call whenever possible.

- Conduct follow-up calls, SMS, and WhatsApp messages until the enrollment process is completed.

- Make approximately 100–150 outbound calls per day.

- Document all client interactions accurately in iAgencyPal CRM.

- Update shared Excel tracking sheets with notes and status updates.

- Coordinate with internal tea
mbers regarding client progress.

- Escalate complex inquiries to the appropriate tea
mber or insurance agent.

- Participate in daily team huddles and coaching sessions.



What This Role Does NOT Include



To set clear expectations, this position does not involve:

- Selling insurance products

- Recommending insurance plans

- Explaining policy benefits or coverage

- Providing licensed insurance advice



Your role is to assist clients in completing their required enrollment paperwork and connect them with the appropriate representative when necessary.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured through:

- 100–150 outbound calls per day per agent

- 15 completed enrollment forms per day per agent

- Accurate CRM documentation

- Timely follow-ups

- Reliable attendance and punctuality



Qualifications



We're looking for candidates with:

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Previous experience in customer service, outbound calling, virtual assistance, administrative support, or a similar role.

- Strong phone etiquette and active listening skills.

- Basic Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets knowledge.

- Strong organizational and documentation skills.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- A quiet work environment.

- A professional headset suitable for remote work.

- Experience in healthcare or insurance is an advantage but not required.



Tools You'll Use



- iAgencyPal CRM

- Nextiva Phone System

- Microsoft Teams

- Outlook

- Shared Excel Tracking Sheets

- WhatsApp



Training & Onboarding



Comprehensive training will be provided before you begin taking calls, training includes:

- Company Overview

- HIPAA & Data Privacy

- Open Enrollment Process

- iAgencyPal CRM

- Nextiva Phone System

- Call Scripts

- Documentation Standards



Training begins on September 28, 2026.



Compensation & Benefits



- PHP 40,600 monthly salary

- Performance incentive program

- Seasonal employment through Native Teams (Employer of Record)

- Company-issued laptop provided for the duration of the seasonal contract



(A company-issued laptop will be provided to successful candidates for use throughout the duration of the seasonal contract. The laptop remains the property of Marketplace Insurance Exchange and must be returned at the end of the engagement in accordance with company policies.)



Application Process



To be considered for this opportunity, please submit the following:



1. Updated Resume



2. Video Introduction (2–3 Minutes)

- Record a short video introducing yourself in English.

- In your video, please tell us:

Introduce yourself.

Briefly describe your professional background and relevant experience.

Tell us about your experience with customer service, outbound calling, virtual assistance, or administrative support.

Share why you're interested in this seasonal opportunity.

Explain why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.



3. Mock Outbound Call Recording

Please submit a separate voice recording using the following script:



Good morning/afternoon. May I please speak with [Client's Name]?

Hi [Client's Name], my name is [Your Name], and I'm calling on behalf of Marketplace Insurance Exchange.

I'm reaching out because we noticed that your Open Enrollment form hasn't been completed yet. I'd be happy to help you complete it today if you have a few minutes available.

Completing this form helps ensure we can continue assisting you with your health coverage.

If now isn't a convenient time, I'd be happy to schedule a callback at a time that works best for you.

If you have questions about your insurance coverage or benefits, I'll make sure your designated insurance agent contacts you as soon as possible.

Thank you for your time today. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to helping you complete your enrollment.



Join Our Team



This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a supportive, collaborative team during one of the most important campaigns of the year. If you're an excellent communicator who enjoys helping people and thrives in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help us make Open Enrollment a success!

title: Time-Lapse / Post Editor | Remote | Full-Time | compensation TBD
description:
Video Editor – Construction Time-Lapse & YouTube Post-Production (Full-Time, WFH)`



Turn 6 months of construction into 16 minutes people can't stop watching.



You build things — garages, barndominiums, full custom structures — and we film every single day of it. Cameras run from the first stake in the ground to the final light switch. What we need is the person who can take thousands of hours of that footage and turn it into a time-lapse that makes viewers say *"whoa"* out loud.



If you've ever watched a start-to-finish build video and thought *"I could cut that better"* — this is your role.



You'll work from home, on a predictable schedule, with a team that actually gives feedback, pays on time, and lets you own your edits.



What You'll Do



- Edit long-form construction time-lapse videos (10–20 min finished runtime) from start-to-finish build footage

- Process interval/GoPro/DSLR time-lapse sequences — deflicker, stabilize, ramp speed, smooth transitions between days

- Sync and cut multicam footage (drone, ground cam, POV, handheld B-roll) into one clean story

- Color correct and color grade for a consistent, punchy look across weeks of changing weather and light

- Design sound: music selection, timing beats to the build, ambient layers, SFX for satisfying 
nts

- Add clean motion graphics — day counters, lower thirds, callouts, titles, end screens

- Cut vertical Shorts/Reels/TikToks from the same footage for social distribution

- Add accurate captions/subtitles and export to spec for YouTube and social platforms

- Manage and organize large footage libraries, project files, and backups

- Apply feedback quickly and hit publish deadlines



What We're Looking For



- 2+ years editing video — time-lapse, construction, real estate, DIY, or documentary experience is a big plus

- Strong with Adobe Premiere Pro **or** DaVinci Resolve (either is fine — we care about the result)

- Comfortable with After Effects or Fusion for basic motion graphics

- Experience handling large media files, proxies, and long-form timelines without breaking a sweat

- A real eye for pacing — you know when to hold a shot and when to cut

- Reliable internet (at least 20 Mbps) and a computer that can handle 4K editing

- Good written English for feedback threads and file notes

- Dependable, organized, and communicates when something's blocking you



**Nice to have (not required):** LRTimelapse, Topaz Video AI, Adobe Audition, drone footage experience, YouTube thumbnail or channel-growth knowledge.



Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. A strong reel beats a long résumé here.



---



About The Company



We're a remote-first media company producing long-form build and construction content for YouTube and social platforms. Our videos document real projects end to end — no staged sets, no stock footage — and our audience shows up for the craft. The team is fully distributed, deadline-driven, and small enough that your edits genuinely shape the channel.



Why Work With Us



- **Your work gets seen.** These aren't corporate videos filed away in a folder — they go out to a real audience that comments on every cut.

- **Creative ownership.** You'll have real input on pacing, music, and structure. We hire editors, not button-pushers.

- **Straight answers.** Clear briefs, honest feedback, no guessing what the client wants.

- **Long-term.** We're looking for someone to grow with the channel for years, not a one-off project hire.

- **Respect for your time.** No surprise midnight revisions, no unpaid "test projects" that run for weeks.



How To Apply



 your application to 
 with:



1. **A video sample in this style** — a time-lapse, construction, build, or start-to-finish edit you personally cut. Send a YouTube, Vimeo, or Google Drive link (make sure the link is set to public or "anyone with the link").

2. **A short introduction about yourself** — a few sentences, or a quick 60-second video if you'd rather talk than type. Tell us who you are, what you edit, and what software you use.

3. Put **BARNDOMINIUM** in your subject line so we know you read the full posting.



That's it — no long forms, no cover letter. Your edit does the talking.



We review applications daily and are hiring immediately. Send your reel now — the sooner it's in, the sooner you're on the shortlist.

title: Senior Video Editor | Wedding Films, Commercial & Cinematic Post-Production
description:
About Us



We are a growing U.S.-based premium production company creating cinematic wedding films, commercial campaigns, branded content, corporate productions, social media content, and longer-form video projects.



We are looking for an experienced professional video editor who can take professionally shot raw footage and turn it into polished, emotionally compelling, high-end films.

Your primary responsibility will be professional post-production and video editing.

We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can grow with our production company as our client volume increases.



What You'll Edit



Projects may include:



Luxury wedding highlight films

Wedding trailers and teasers

Full wedding films

Ceremony and reception edits

Commercial advertisements

Brand campaigns

Corporate videos

Interviews

Testimonials

Documentary-style content

Multicamera productions

YouTube and longer-form content

Social media cutdowns created from larger productions

Primary Responsibilities

Professional Video Editing



You will be responsible for taking projects from organized raw footage through final delivery.



This includes:



Reviewing and selecting footage

Building compelling storylines

Multicam editing

Syncing multiple cameras and professional audio

Dialogue editing

Music selection and editing

Sound design

Audio mixing and cleanup

Color correction

Cinematic color grading

Creating smooth and intentional transitions

Speed ramping when appropriate

Stabilization

Noise reduction

Basic visual effects

Titles and graphics

Creating multiple versions and aspect ratios

Exporting optimized final deliverables

Managing revisions efficiently

Wedding Film Editing



You must understand that great wedding films are about story and emotion, not simply beautiful shots.



You should be comfortable working with:



Bride and groom preparation

First looks

Ceremony footage

Vows

Speeches

Reception footage

Drone footage

Multiple camera angles

Separate professional audio recordings



You should be able to use vows, speeches, music, natural audio, and visual storytelling to create emotionally powerful wedding films.



Commercial & Brand Editing



You should also be comfortable editing professional commercial work including:



Brand campaigns

Corporate storytelling

Product videos

Social advertising

Interviews

Testimonials

Promotional films

Lifestyle campaigns



You should understand how commercial editing differs from wedding storytelling and be able to adapt to different brand identities.



Technical Requirements



Strong professional experience with at least one major editing platform is required:



Preferred:



Adobe Premiere Pro



Also accepted:



DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro



Experience with the following is highly preferred:



Adobe After Effects

Adobe Audition

DaVinci Resolve for professional color grading

Photoshop





You should understand professional workflows involving:



4K footage

Log footage

Proxies

LUTs

Multicam sequences

Frame rates

Codecs

Color spaces

Audio synchronization

External audio recorders

Professional export settings

Project archiving

Speed Matters



We want exceptional quality, but we also operate a business with deadlines.



You must be capable of producing excellent work efficiently.



You should be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously while meeting agreed-upon turnaround times.



Depending on the project, turnaround expectations may include:



Wedding teaser: 24–72 hours

Social media cutdowns: 24–72 hours

Wedding highlight film: approximately 5–10 business days

Commercial projects: based on project scope and deadline



Quality should never be sacrificed simply to work quickly, but efficiency is extremely important.



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate:



Has excellent storytelling instincts

Understands pacing and emotion

Has strong musical instincts

Understands professional audio

Is highly skilled in color correction and grading

Is extremely organized

Can follow a creative brief

Can also make intelligent creative decisions independently

Pays close attention to details

Communicates proactively

Meets deadlines

Handles revisions professionally

Can maintain a consistent brand style across projects

Understands that premium work requires refinement

Required Experience



Applicants should ideally have professional experience editing:



Wedding films

Commercial productions

Brand content

Multicamera footage

Professional audio



Experience editing only TikToks, Reels, or basic CapCut videos is not sufficient for this position.



Social media editing experience is useful, but we are specifically seeking someone with professional post-production capabilities.



Bonus Skills

Motion graphics

Animation

Professional sound design

Advanced DaVinci Resolve color grading

Documentary editing

Trailer editing

Luxury wedding editing

Fashion or beauty campaign experience

AI-assisted post-production workflows

Work Style

We value:



Clear communication

Reliability

Responsiveness

Accountability

Creative collaboration

Consistency

Long-term growth

A structured project-based arrangement initially with the opportunity to transition into a long-term full-time role.

title: Senior B2B inbound Sales & Design Specialist
description:
We're looking for a rare combination...



We're looking for a rock-star B2B salesperson who also has a strong creative and design background.



Someone who can take an inbound enquiry from a business, understand exactly what the customer is trying to achieve, come up with a creative solution, turn their idea into a professional visual mock-up, price it accurately — and then confidently turn that enquiry into a sale.



This isn't a traditional "make 50 cold calls a day" sales role.



Our customers are already coming to us. Your job is to turn those opportunities into great customer experiences and profitable orders.



You'll be working with businesses looking for printed signage, graphics and branded visual solutions, helping them take an idea from initial enquiry through to a finished product.



What you'll actually be doing

???? Managing inbound B2B enquiries



You'll be the first point of contact for businesses enquiring about our products.



You'll respond to enquiries via
 and enquiry forms, understand what the customer needs, ask the right questions and recommend the best solution.



You'll need to be commercially minded — understanding not just what the customer is asking for, but what they're actually trying to achieve.



???? Creating simple visual concepts & quick mock-ups



This is a big part of the role.



You'll use Adobe Illustrator to create quick visuals showing customers what their signage, graphics or branding could look like at the correct scale.



For example:



"Here's what your logo would look like as a 3D acrylic sign on your reception wall."



Or:



"Here's how your new window graphics could look across the front of your office."



You'll take customer logos, artwork, measurements and ideas and turn them into visuals that make it easy for the customer to say "Yes — that's exactly what I want."



???? Quoting & pricing

We have a shopify website and send all our quotes to clients through
.



That means understanding the requirements, calculating the correct pricing, considering materials, production and installation requirements where relevant, and presenting the quote professionally.



You'll need a good commercial instinct — knowing when to protect margin, when to offer alternatives and how to increase the value of an order without simply discounting.



???? Converting enquiries into orders - all over
.



You'll manage opportunities from initial enquiry through to close.



Customer enquiry ? Understanding the brief ? Creative concept ? Illustrator mock-up ? Quote ? Follow-up ? Sale



That includes following up quotes, answering questions, overcoming objections, recommending alternatives and making sure opportunities don't fall through the cracks.



You don't need to be pushy or overly salesy.



We're looking for someone who is confident, consultative and commercially sharp.



???? Helping customers make better decisions



A big part of our value is helping customers who don't necessarily know exactly what they want.



They might say:



"We've just moved into a new office and need something for this wall."



You'll be able to take that vague brief and turn it into a clear recommendation:



What should they buy?

What size should it be?

What material would work best?

How will it look?

What will it cost?



That's where your combination of sales + design + commercial thinking really comes into its own.



Who we're looking for



We're looking for someone experienced, ambitious and seriously good at what they do.



You'll probably have experience in one or more of the following:



B2B sales

Inbound sales

Signage / print / graphics

Large-format print

Interior branding

Exhibition graphics

Commercial design

Graphic design

Digital print

Branding / marketing production



But your background doesn't have to tick every box.



What matters is that you're commercially minded, creative and know how to deal with customers.



You must be confident using Adobe Illustrator.



You don't need to be the world's greatest graphic designer!



But you should be comfortable taking a logo or piece of artwork, manipulating it, creating layouts, producing mock-ups and preparing professional visuals for customers.



You'll also need to be comfortable working with numbers in GBP, pricing jobs and putting together quotes.



The person we're looking for



You'll probably be someone who:



???? Thinks commercially

You understand margin, value and what makes a customer buy.



???? Has a creative brain

You naturally think about how something could look better, work better or be presented more effectively.



???? Communicates brilliantly

You can talk to a business owner or marketing manager and quickly understand what they're trying to achieve.



? Moves quickly

Inbound sales is about speed. When a great enquiry lands, you don't want to be sitting on it for three days.



???? Has attention to detail

Measurements, materials, quantities, artwork and pricing all need to be right.



???? Takes ownership

You don't need someone chasing you to follow up a quote or move an opportunity forward.

We also have systems in place, and can create more automations etc along the way.



???? Wants to win

You're motivated by results, you enjoy closing deals and you want to be rewarded when you perform.



Who are we?



We are Hyper Creative - a UK based online B2B print, signage and graphics company that has been in business for 15 years.

We have 6 VAs in the Philopines - and so we know exactly how to set you up for success and train you up.

We offer design, print and install services - so the projects we work on typically range from £250 upto £8,000 GBP



Hours - We would expect you to work 9am - 5pm Monday - Friday - London time zone.





Interested? - Next Steps:







Send us your CV along with a short note explaining why you think you'd be a great fit for the role.



Bonus points: Send us examples of signage, branding, mock-ups or other creative work you've produced.



We'd much rather see what you can actually do than read another generic CV.

* Organize references, inspiration, scripts, hooks, and creative direction
