title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

title: Bookkeeper (QuickBooks)
description:
We're looking for a **Bookkeeper** with deep QuickBooks expertise to own the books for a fast-moving, fully remote software holding company operating across multiple products and revenue streams. You will manage day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations, reporting, and financial record-keeping with minimal oversight and maximum accuracy.



This is a high-ownership, execution-driven role. You will not be given detailed instructions on how to manage the books — you are expected to know QuickBooks inside and out, set up and maintain clean financial records independently, and surface the right information to leadership without being asked. If you are a strong bookkeeper who lives in QuickBooks, takes full ownership of financial accuracy, and can operate reliably in a fully async remote environment, this role is a strong fit.



## Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy

- Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines

- **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive

- This role requires availability during **US business hours**

- Work inside a lean, profitable software holding company with multiple active revenue streams

- High-ownership bookkeeping role with direct access to leadership and real impact on financial visibility



## What You'll Work On



**Day-to-Day Bookkeeping**



- Manage all day-to-day bookkeeping activity including recording transactions, categorizing expenses, and maintaining accurate financial records

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processor accounts on a regular basis

- Ensure the chart of accounts is organized, consistent, and accurate across all entities and revenue streams

- Process accounts payable and accounts receivable and keep all records current



**QuickBooks Management**



- Own and maintain the QuickBooks environment end to end including setup, configuration, and ongoing maintenance

- Build and manage workflows within QuickBooks that keep financial operations clean and efficient

- Troubleshoot discrepancies, reconciliation issues, and data inconsistencies independently

- Leverage QuickBooks features fully to automate and streamline recurring bookkeeping tasks



**Reporting and Financial Visibility**



- Generate regular financial reports including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow summaries

- Surface key financial insights and flag anomalies or issues to leadership proactively

- Maintain organized financial records that are audit-ready at all times

- Support month-end and year-end close processes accurately and on time



**Coordination and Compliance Support**



- Coordinate with external accountants or tax advisors as needed to support filings and compliance requirements

- Maintain clean documentation of all financial activity for internal and external reference

- Support ad hoc financial requests from leadership with speed and accuracy



## What You Bring



- Deep, hands-on QuickBooks proficiency — you know the platform thoroughly and can set it up, manage it, and troubleshoot it independently

- Proven bookkeeping experience managing full-cycle books for a business with multiple revenue streams

- Strong reconciliation skills with a zero-tolerance approach to inaccuracies

- Ability to work fully independently in a remote environment without requiring close supervision

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through

- Clear written English communication skills for coordinating with leadership and external advisors

- Reliable and discreet when handling sensitive financial information

- Available to work full-time during US business hours



## Nice to Have



- QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification

- Experience bookkeeping for SaaS, software, or subscription-based businesses

- Familiarity with multi-entity or holding company financial structures

- Experience coordinating with international accountants or tax advisors

- Background supporting a bootstrapped or founder-led company



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your **updated resume**

2. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your QuickBooks experience, and walking through how you have managed the books for a business with multiple revenue streams or entities



**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**



If you are a QuickBooks expert who takes full ownership of financial accuracy and wants to manage the books for a growing portfolio of software products, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.

title: Amazon Paid Media Strategist
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Paid Media Strategist to oversee the strategy, performance, and optimization of paid media across our Amazon portfolio.



This role will serve as the internal expert on Amazon advertising performance, ensuring that our media investment is driving profitable, sustainable growth. The Paid Media Strategist will monitor campaign performance, identify opportunities and inefficiencies, provide actionable recommendations, and help determine where we should scale, optimize, test, or reduce investment.



This person will work closely with our Marketplace Analyst on data and performance analytics and our Category Brand Manager on organic strategy, ensuring that paid media, organic visibility, content, pricing, promotions, and overall brand strategy are working together.



The ideal candidate is highly analytical but also understands the bigger picture of growing brands on Amazon.



Paid Media Strategy & Optimization



· Oversee Amazon paid media strategy across multiple brands and product categories.



· Monitor Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other Amazon advertising initiatives.



· Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, conversion, traffic, and overall profitability.



· Recommend where advertising investment should be increased, reduced, reallocated, or tested.



· Evaluate campaign structure, targeting, bidding, keyword strategy, budgets, placements, and search term performance.



· Identify wasted spend and opportunities to improve advertising efficiency.



· Help establish advertising goals and budgets by brand based on growth objectives, profitability, inventory, and opportunity.



Performance Analysis & Reporting



· Work closely with the Marketplace Analyst to analyze advertising performance alongside sales, traffic, conversion, organic ranking, profitability, and competitive trends.



· Develop clear reporting and recommendations that explain not only what happened, but why performance changed and what actions should be taken.



· Identify trends and opportunities at the brand, category, campaign, keyword, and ASIN level.



· Establish benchmarks and KPIs to measure advertising effectiveness.



· HPaid + Organic Collaboration



· Partner closely with Category Brand Managers to connect paid media strategy with organic Amazon strategy.



· Evaluate how content, SEO, pricing, promotions, reviews, inventory, and organic ranking are impacting advertising performance.



· Identify opportunities where paid media can support organic keyword growth and overall discoverability.



· Collaborate on new product launches and brand growth strategies.



· Ensure paid and organic strategies complement one another rather than functioning in silos.



Agency Management & Accountability



· Serve as an internal strategic counterpart to external advertising agencies and technology partners.



· Review agency recommendations and challenge strategies when performance or data does not support them.



· Ensure agencies are delivering against agreed-upon KPIs and business objectives.



· Provide internal analysis so the company maintains ownership of advertising strategy and decision-making.



· Identify areas where agency strategies should be adjusted, expanded, or reduced.



· Help ensure advertising partners are proactively bringing forward opportunities rather than simply managing existing campaigns.



Qualifications



· 3+ years of hands-on experience managing or overseeing Amazon advertising.



· Experience managing advertising across multiple brands and/or a large Amazon catalog strongly preferred.



· Advanced analytical skills with the ability to turn large amounts of data into clear recommendations.



· Strong understanding of ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC, profitability, and other Amazon performance metrics.



· Understanding of the relationship between paid advertising, organic ranking, SEO, content, pricing, promotions, and conversion.



· Experience working with Amazon advertising platforms, agencies, or third-party advertising technology.



· Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both analytical and non-analytical stakeholders.



· Strong English communication skills.





What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is naturally curious and analytical and who isn't satisfied with simply reporting numbers.



This person should be comfortable asking:



Why did performance change? Where are we overspending? Where should we be investing more? Are paid campaigns actually creating incremental growth? How is paid media impacting organic performance? What should we change next?



The right candidate will be comfortable challenging assumptions, digging into the data, and making recommendations that improve both advertising efficiency and overall Amazon growth.

title: Digital Marketing, Social Media & Automation Manager
description:
KLN Consulting







Position Overview and Performance Expectations



The Digital Marketing, Social Media & Automation Manager is responsible for managing and improving KLN Consulting’s complete digital marketing presence, social media activity, lead-generation systems, GoHighLevel platform, marketing automations, funnels, campaigns, digital content, and AI-supported business processes.



This is not simply a social media posting position. The person selected for this role must understand how content, technology, automation, lead management, branding, customer communication, and data work together to generate business growth.



The manager is expected to create content, manage marketing systems, monitor results, identify problems, build solutions, improve conversion opportunities, and ensure every digital system functions properly.



Primary areas of responsibility



1. Social media management



The manager will oversee KLN Consulting’s approved social platforms, including:

*

*
 Groups

Responsibilities include:



* Creating and maintaining the social media content calendar.

* Designing and publishing professional branded content.

* Writing captions, headlines, hooks, and calls to action.

* Creating short-form videos, reels, graphics, educational posts, promotional content, and company updates.

* Scheduling posts in advance.

* Monitoring comments, messages, mentions, and engagement.

* Responding professionally or routing inquiries to the correct department.

* Turning social media inquiries into properly documented leads.

* Ensuring leads are entered into GHL with the correct source, tags, pipeline, and follow-up task.

* Monitoring performance and adjusting content based on results.

* Protecting KLN’s brand identity, voice, reputation, and professional image.



2. Required content production



Minimum content expectations include:



* 10–14 social media posts per week

* At least 40 social media posts per month

* At least 3 short-form videos or reels per week

* At least 2 LinkedIn posts per week

* At least 1 blog article per week

* At least 4 blog articles per month

* Instagram and
 stories posted consistently throughout the workweek

* Promotional and campaign content completed by assigned deadlines

* Content calendar maintained at least two weeks in advance



Content should include:



* Credit education

* Tax education

* Client education

* Industry information

* Testimonials and approved client success stories

* Frequently asked questions

* Company updates

* Partnerships

* Promotions

* Calls to action

* Leadership and business content

* Trust-building educational content



Content must be original, professional, accurate, and consistent with KLN Consulting’s branding.



3. Digital marketing management



The manager will be responsible for planning, launching, monitoring, and improving digital marketing campaigns.



Responsibilities include:



* Developing marketing strategies for KLN services.

* Creating campaign concepts and offers.

* Identifying target audiences.

* Creating campaign messaging and supporting content.

* Coordinating organic and paid marketing.

* Testing different headlines, creative assets, audiences, and calls to action.

* Monitoring lead quality and campaign performance.

* Identifying why leads are or are not converting.

* Recommending changes based on actual data.

* Tracking marketing spend when paid campaigns are assigned.

* Ensuring forms, landing pages, links, tracking, and follow-up systems work before a campaign launches.

* Providing accurate weekly and monthly marketing reports.

* Stopping or escalating campaigns that are spending money without producing acceptable results.



No campaign, advertisement, offer, discount, guarantee, or public statement may be launched without the required approval.



4. GoHighLevel ownership



The candidate must have advanced working knowledge of GoHighLevel and be able to manage the platform independently.



GHL responsibilities include:



* Contacts

* Opportunities

* Pipelines

* Pipeline stages

* Tags

* Custom fields

* Calendars

* Appointment scheduling

* Forms

* Surveys

* Landing pages

* Funnels

 campaigns

* Automations

* Triggers

* Tasks

* Notes

* Conversations

* Lead assignment

* Reporting

* User access and permissions

The manager must ensure:



* Every new lead enters the correct pipeline.

5. Funnels and lead-generation systems



The manager will oversee the complete digital customer journey:



Marketing ? Lead ? Funnel ? Appointment ? Enrollment ? Client ? Retention

* Creating landing pages and forms.

 and SMS drafts

Monthly AI and automation expectations include:



* Identify at least 3 automation opportunities per month.

* Improve or build at least 2 workflows per month.

* Recommend at least 1 process improvement per month that reduces manual work.

7. Website and digital presence

* Follow-up tasks created.

* No qualified lead left without follow-up.

* Important conversations documented.

* Serious client concerns escalated immediately.



The manager must not provide unapproved financial, credit, funding, tax, or legal advice through social media.



9. Brand and compliance standards



All marketing must follow KLN Consulting standards.



The manager must ensure:



* Correct logo, colors, fonts, voice, and visual identity are used.

* Content is professional and free from spelling or grammatical errors.

* Pricing and service information are accurate.

* No guaranteed credit, funding, tax, or financial results are promised.

* No misleading before-and-after claims are published.

* Client information is never shared without authorization.

* Testimonials and results have the required approval.

* Sensitive information is protected.

* Promotions and discounts receive approval before publication.

* Public responses do not expose private client matters.

* Errors are corrected quickly and reported to leadership.



10. Reporting and performance tracking



The manager must track and report:

* Reels and videos published

* LinkedIn posts

* Blogs completed

* Reach

* Impressions

* Engagement

* Saves

* Appointments booked

* No-shows

* Applications or enrollments

* Conversions

* Cost per lead

* Cost per acquisition

* Campaign spending

* Revenue attributed to marketing

* Funnel performance

* Workflow performance

* Automation failures

* Improvements completed



Weekly report



A weekly marketing and digital operations report must be submitted every Friday.



It must include:



* Content completed

* Content not completed

* Posting totals

* Engagement results

* Leads generated

* GHL activity

* Funnel status

* Campaign performance

* Automation issues

* Website issues

* Missed deadlines

* Problems identified

* Actions taken

* Priorities for the following week



Monthly report



A complete monthly report must be submitted by the last business day of each month.



It must include:



* Total content published

* Performance by platform

* Lead-generation results

* Conversion results

* Campaign performance

* GHL and pipeline performance

* Funnel performance

* Website updates

* Blogs and LinkedIn activity

* AI and automation improvements

* Problems and corrections

* Growth opportunities

* Recommendations

* Next month’s strategy and goals



Strict performance standards



The manager is expected to maintain:



* 95% or higher content and system quality

* 100% of approved posts published by their deadlines

* 100% of leads routed and documented correctly

* 100% of active workflows tested before launch

* All social inquiries acknowledged within 24 hours

* All weekly and monthly reports submitted on time

* No unauthorized campaigns, pricing, guarantees, or promotions

* No falsified marketing, lead, campaign, or conversion data

* No client information disclosed without authorization

* No repeated posting failures without immediate communication and a correction plan



Repeated missed deadlines, inaccurate reporting, broken workflows, unprofessional content, failure to follow up with leads, or failure to follow approval processes may result in coaching or corrective action.



Required experience and qualifications



The ideal candidate must have:



* Proven social media management experience.

* The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting ability.

* Willingness to accept feedback and make corrections quickly.



Final standard



Success in this role means KLN Consulting has a consistent and professional digital presence, functional GHL systems, accurate automations, organized lead management, strong content, measurable marketing results, and a reliable customer journey.



The Digital Marketing, Social Media & Automation Manager is expected to take ownership, identify problems before they become larger issues, create solutions, improve systems, generate opportunities, and help KLN Consulting grow.

title: US Tax Reviewer | Remote | Pampanga
description:
US Tax Reviewer | Remote | Pampanga

Philippines (100% Remote) · Full-Time Independent Contractor ·



Be the final set of eyes that says “this is ready to file.” You review completed returns across all major entity types, catch what others miss, and own the accuracy of every return that goes out the door.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll serve as the final checkpoint in the tax workflow — the reviewer of record. Preparers hand off completed 1040s, 1120s, 1120-S, and 1065s; you make sure they’re right before they’re filed. You’ll spot calculation errors, missed elections, and documentation gaps, then coordinate with the preparer to get them resolved.



This is a higher-accountability role than preparation, and the compensation reflects it. You’ll communicate directly with clients — but strictly to clarify questions about the return itself. No advisory services. No planning conversations. Just clean, accurate returns and clear answers about what’s on them.



You’ll work in Drake and a proprietary internal platform (training provided), partner with U.S.-based teams on technical questions, and help raise the quality bar across the workflow.



The Ideal Candidate

You’re the person other reviewers double-check their work against

You can spot a missing K-1 footnote, a wrong basis calculation, or a miscoded depreciation method on the first pass

You stay in your lane on client calls — you answer what’s on the return, not what could be

You’re comfortable being the last name on the file

You believe a clean review note saves three rounds of rework



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Return Review & Sign-Off

Be the final checkpoint before filing.

Review completed returns across 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065 — federal and multi-state

Verify K-1s, capital accounts, basis, at-risk, §199A treatment, and reasonable comp where applicable

Reconcile book-to-tax adjustments, depreciation schedules, and carryforwards (NOL, capital loss, AMT, PALs)

Validate apportionment, nexus, composite/PTE elections, and state-specific quirks

Confirm e-file readiness: forms, signatures, acknowledgments, and extensions



Quality Control & Issue Resolution

Catch it before it ships.

Identify gaps, errors, or unclear treatment in prepared returns

Write clear, actionable review notes preparers can resolve without back-and-forth

Coordinate with the preparer through resolution; verify fixes before final sign-off

Escalate technical questions to internal U.S.-based colleagues when needed



Client Communication (Return-Scoped Only)

Answer what’s on the return — nothing more.

Respond to client questions specifically about line items, calculations, or filings on the prepared return

Explain results clearly without offering advisory or planning recommendations

Redirect advisory questions to the appropriate party



Tools & Workflow

Work cleanly in the tools that ship returns.

Drake tax software (preferred experience)

Proprietary internal platform — training provided

Maintain audit-ready workpapers and documentation trails



Data Integrity

Leave a trail anyone can follow.

Keep folders organized, naming consistent, and documentation complete so any reviewer or auditor can follow your work quickly



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Extensive experience reviewing and/or preparing U.S. tax returns across 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065

Deep familiarity with state tax filings across multiple jurisdictions

High degree of accuracy and professional judgment; comfortable taking final accountability for filed returns

Strong communication skills for both client-facing (return-specific) and internal correspondence

Experience with Drake tax software preferred

Confident written and spoken English; client-facing presence

Comfortable working U.S. business hours (night shift, PH-based)

Preferred (nice to have):



CPA designation strongly preferred

Experience with R&D tax credits (Form 6765)

Familiarity with NYC local tax filings

Prior review or supervisory tax role



HOW WE WORK

Quality: Review notes, standardized workpapers, and tidy supporting schedules — every time

Security: MFA, least-privilege access, and secure file sharing are non-negotiable

Collaboration: Slack/Zoom/Teams standups, shared task boards, and predictable review cycles



WHY CAS IS DIFFERENT

We are not a gig platform. We are not a freelance marketplace. We are not short-term staffing.

We invest in professionals who want to build a real career serving U.S. clients. At CAS, you get:

Career-level USD compensation based on experience and scope (senior-level positioning for this role)

Permanent remote work — done right

Full company equipment provided (laptop, monitor, accessories)

15 days PTO annually + local holidays off

Guaranteed annual increases

Referral rewards up to $1,000

Monthly flexible stipend (CAS Flex Perks)

Structured onboarding and support

A culture that actually shows up



CONTRACT & EXCLUSIVITY

This is an independent contractor engagement based in the Philippines. Full-time exclusivity is required — candidates must not hold other part-time or freelance engagements once hired. Conflict-of-interest checks may apply.



APPLICATION PROCESS

Application & Prescreening

Technical Assessment

Profile and Pre-interview Preparation

Client Interview

Employment Offer and Onboarding

Position: Salesforce CRM & Marketing Automation Specialist



Salary: PHP 50,000 per month



Schedule: Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



Strong Salesforce experience



Experience building and managing CRM workflows, automations, lead pipelines, and reporting



Experience creating custom landing pages, forms, and lead capture systems



Ability to create and launch landing pages quickly



Portfolio and work samples required



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills



HIGHLY PREFERRED



Salesforce Experience



Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses



Experience with marketing automation and lead generation campaigns



Experience with social media and digital marketing initiatives



IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



Applicants should be prepared to provide examples of previous work during the interview process.



Examples may include:



• Salesforce workflows, automations, reports, or dashboards you have built



• Landing pages you have created



• CRM workflows and automations you have developed



• Marketing campaigns you have supported





Candidates who cannot provide examples of previous work may not be considered.



---



We are hiring a full-time Salesforce CRM & Marketing Automation Specialist to support a fast-growing U.S.-based healthcare and wellness organization.



This role is ideal for someone who has hands-on experience with Salesforce, CRM administration, marketing automation, landing page development, lead generation systems, and digital marketing support.



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive professional who can build, maintain, and optimize the systems that support our marketing, lead generation, and customer acquisition efforts.



Key Responsibilities



• Maintain and optimize Salesforce CRM and marketing systems



• Support Salesforce administration as needed



• Build and manage workflows, automations, forms, and lead nurturing campaigns



• Create and maintain custom landing pages and lead capture funnels



• Manage lead pipelines, reporting, dashboards, campaign tracking, and CRM data



• Assist with digital marketing initiatives and social media support



• Implement integrations and troubleshoot technical issues



• Monitor CRM performance and recommend process improvements



• Maintain SOPs, workflow documentation, and internal records



• Support special projects and business growth initiatives as assigned



Requirements



• Bachelor's Degree preferred



• Minimum 2 years of experience in Salesforce administration, CRM administration, marketing automation, digital marketing, or a related field



• Advanced Salesforce experience required



• Strong understanding of CRM workflows, automations, reporting, and pipeline management



• Experience creating landing pages, lead generation campaigns, and marketing automations



• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills



• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills



• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously



To Be Considered, Please Submit



1. Resume



2. OnlineJobs Profile Link



3. Portfolio and/or work samples



4. Examples of landing pages you have built



5. Examples of Salesforce workflows, CRM automations, reports, or dashboards you have created



6. Brief summary of your Salesforce experience



7. List any Salesforce, HubSpot, Go High Level, or CRM-related certifications you hold



Applications without portfolio samples or examples of previous work will not be considered.



Work Setup



• Full-time, permanent remote position



• Philippines-based candidates only



• Must be available during U.S. business hours



• Flexibility for occasional weekend coverage may be required



Compensation



PHP 50,000 per month starting salary



Performance and compensation reviews based on growth and contribution



Benefits



• Work from home



• Paid training



• Opportunities for advancement and increased responsibilities



• Long-term career opportunity with a rapidly growing U.S.-based organization



We are looking for someone who enjoys building systems, solving problems, and helping businesses grow through automation and technology. This is an excellent opportunity for a CRM and marketing automation professional who wants to take ownership of CRM operations while growing with an organization long term.



We are not looking for temporary tea
mbers. We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career, grow with the organization, and become a key contributor as the company continues to expand.

title: Senior Loan Officer Assistant / Pre-Underwriting Specialist
description:
We are a U.S.-based mortgage brokerage looking for an experienced **Senior Loan Officer Assistant / Pre-Underwriting Specialist** to join our team full-time.



**Schedule:** 40 hours/week, U.S. Pacific Time business hours

**Compensation:** $1,500–$2,000 USD/month, depending on experience and demonstrated technical ability.



This is NOT a basic administrative LOA or document-chasing position.



The primary responsibility of this role is to help our Loan Officer **review and analyze borrower scenarios BEFORE pre-approval and underwriting submission.**



We need someone who can independently think through a mortgage file, identify potential problems, calculate qualifying income, review AUS findings and guidelines, and provide a clear recommendation.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Review 1003, credit, income, assets, liabilities, REO and supporting documentation

• Perform front-end / pre-underwriting file review

• Calculate qualifying income and DTI

• Review funds to close and reserve requirements

• Identify missing documents and underwriting red flags

• Run and review DU / LP (LPA) findings

• Research agency and lender guidelines when necessary

• Assist with loan structuring and pre-approval analysis

• Present findings and recommended next steps clearly to the Loan Officer



INCOME ANALYSIS



Strong income calculation experience is important.



Candidate should be comfortable reviewing:



• W-2 / Salary / Hourly

• Overtime / Bonus / Commission

• 1099

• Schedule C

• Self-employed borrowers

• 1120S / S-Corporations

• 1065 / Partnerships

• K-1s

• Personal and business tax returns

• P&L statements

• Rental income

• Social Security / Pension / Retirement income



Strong self-employed income analysis experience is highly preferred.



LOAN PROGRAM EXPERIENCE



Strong Conventional knowledge is required.



Experience with the following is preferred:



• Conventional

• FHA

• VA

• Jumbo

• DSCR

• Bank Statement

• 1099 / P&L

• Asset Utilization / Asset Depletion

• Foreign National / ITIN

• Other Non-QM programs



QUALIFICATIONS



• 3+ years of recent U.S. residential mortgage experience

• Prior experience as a Senior LOA, Processor, Pre-Underwriter, Underwriting Assistant, Junior Underwriter, or similar role

• Strong income calculation skills

• Experience reviewing self-employed borrowers and tax returns

• Experience with DU and/or LP

• Strong understanding of credit, assets, liabilities, DTI and reserves

• Strong written and spoken English

• Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving ability

• Able to work independently during U.S. Pacific Time business hours



Experience with ARIVE, UWM, Encompass, LendingPad and wholesale lender portals is a plus.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are not looking for someone whose mortgage experience is primarily data entry, document collection, borrower follow-up or condition chasing.



We are looking for someone who can answer:



**“Does this borrower qualify, what are the potential problems, and what should we do next?”**



You do not need to know every guideline fro
mory. However, you should know how to research guidelines and return with a well-reasoned answer or possible solution.



COMPENSATION



$1,500–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and demonstrated technical ability.



We are willing to pay toward the higher end for someone who can independently review complex scenarios, analyze self-employed income, interpret DU/LP findings, identify underwriting problems, research guidelines, and provide clear recommendations.



Exceptional candidates with significant underwriting experience may be considered above the stated range.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



**PRE-UW REVIEW**



Then answer the following:



1. How many years of U.S. residential mortgage experience do you have, and what mortgage positions have you held?



2. Have you personally reviewed borrower files before pre-approval or underwriting submission? Describe your responsibilities.



3. Which types of income can you independently calculate? Please specifically address W-2, bonus/commission, Schedule C, 1120S, 1065, K-1 and rental income.



4. Describe your experience analyzing self-employed borrowers and business/personal tax returns.



5. Have you personally run DU and/or LP/LPA and reviewed the findings?



6. Which loan programs are you strongest in? Please include any Non-QM experience.



7. Have you used ARIVE? If yes, describe your experience.



8. Describe ONE difficult mortgage scenario you personally reviewed. What was the issue, how did you identify it, and what solution did you recommend?



9. A Loan Officer sends you a new borrower and asks: “Can this borrower qualify?” Walk us through how you would review the file.



10. What is your expected monthly compensation in USD?



11. Can you work 40 hours/week during U.S. Pacific Time business hours?



12. When can you start?



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a **mortgage case-review assessment** before the final interview.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber with strong U.S. mortgage knowledge, analytical ability, ownership, and problem-solving skills.

title: Part-time Social Media Content Coordinator
description:
US law firm and title company in Florida looking for one experienced social media and content coordinator to run our social channels, newsletters, and event design for both brands. Long-term role. Direct work with the firm owner.

Salary

$900 to $1,200 USD per month for 20 hours per week, based on experience. Paid monthly via Wise or your preferred method. 13th month bonus after first year.

Schedule

20 hours per week. This position will ultimately become fully async. You will be able to set your own hours with no graveyard shift required. An exception will be for the first 30-45 days while you are learning about me and the firm & title company. 

The two brands

• Wilkes & Mee, PLLC. Law firm. Active on LinkedIn,
, Instagram, and TikTok. Needs more consistency and stronger written content.

• Accelerated Title Solutions, LLC. Title company. No social presence yet. You will set everything up from scratch on LinkedIn,
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

What you will own

• Plan and publish content across every social channel for both brands

• Write and send monthly newsletters in Mailchimp to past and current clients

• Design posters, event flyers, and graphics in Canva (or similar) when needed

• Maintain brand voice consistency across both companies (we will train you on each voice)

• Take keyword and topic guidance from our SEO and Paid Media specialist and turn it into posts, captions, and short-form video

• Bring your own ideas. You build the calendar. You will not be handed one.

Reporting (non-negotiable)

Every Friday you send Alisa a weekly report. The report includes:

• What you posted or published, by channel, with links

• Follower growth, engagement, reach, and best/worst performing post per channel

• Newsletter open and click rates when applicable

• What is working and what is not, in your own words

• Your plan for next week and what you need from Alisa to execute it

If you cannot commit to a weekly report with real numbers, this is not the role for you.

Requirements

• 3+ years running social media and content for a business or agency

• Strong written English. This role is roughly 70 percent writing.

• Solid Canva skills with a clean design eye

• Mailchimp experience

• Regular use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your daily workflow

• Self-managing. You can run a full week of work from a Loom video and a Slack channel.

Nice to have

• Content experience for a US law firm, real estate, or other regulated industry 

• Short-form video editing for TikTok and Reels

• Past experience working alongside a separate SEO or paid media specialist

To apply, send the following

• Short note (not a cover letter) on why this role interests you

• Three writing samples you personally wrote (social posts, blog, newsletter, or ad copy). Tell me which platform each was for and how it performed.

• Two or three links to social accounts you have managed or Canva designs you have created

• One or two sample weekly or monthly client reports you have sent in a past role, with any client info redacted. Required. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

• Your requested rate for 20 hours per week

Please do not apply if

• You use agency speak (synergy, leverage, rockstar, ninja)

• You do not use AI tools yourself

• You are looking for a short-term project. This is a long-term role.

title: Paid Growth Specialist – Google Ads, Meta & Performance Marketing
description:

You'll also work alongside tea
mbers focused on creative, content, SEO, conversion optimization, and outreach, so you can focus primarily on what you do best — paid advertising and growth.

Participate in regular tea
etings

Strong experience with Google Ads

Experience with Meta/Facebook/Instagram Ads

Understanding of CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and other paid advertising metrics

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Good written and spoken English

Google Shopping / Merchant Center

Reddit Ads

YouTube Ads

Google Tag Manager

Looker Studio

Conversion tracking

A/B testing

Landing page optimization

title: US Tax Accountant | Remote | Pampanga
description:
US Tax Accountant | Pampanga

Philippines (100% Remote) · Full-Time Independent Contractor · $1,800–$2,900 USD/month ·

Be the expert clients trust at the 
nt it matters most — tax time. You prepare and review complex returns, lead smart tax planning, and turn dense regulations into practical guidance people can actually act on.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll own the work that keeps leaders calm and compliant: multi-entity return preparation and review, clear planning memos, airtight workpapers, and timely sign-offs. You’ll spot elections, credits, and apportionment issues before they become problems — then explain them in plain English.

You’ll collaborate with U.S.-based teams, mentor junior staff, and help modernize how small businesses and CPA firms handle compliance and advisory. You’ll sharpen playbooks — checklists, review notes, and close calendars — so every busy season feels a little less busy.

Note: This role is open to both Tax Accountant and Tax Manager candidates, depending on experience.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

You’re detail-obsessed but practical — you know when to go deep and when to move

You can explain tough topics (basis, §199A, depreciation methods) without jargon

You thrive in busy seasons because your SOPs, checklists, and calendars are dialed in

You enjoy coaching others and raising the quality bar

You look for automation and small process wins that compound over time



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Tax Preparation & Review

Own the work that keeps clients calm and compliant.

Drive tax intake end-to-end: organizers, smart document requests, kickoff calls; map client TBs and prior-year returns to this year’s workplan

Entity returns (1065/1120/1120-S): build and review K-1s, capital accounts, partner/shareholder basis and at-risk; evaluate §199A (QBI) eligibility and limitations; assess reasonable compensation for S-corp shareholder-employees

Individual returns (1040): prepare clean Schedules A/B/C/D/E, Form 4797, 6252, passive activity loss and basis tracking, 1099-B reconciliations, wash sale checks; roll forward carryforwards (NOL, capital loss, AMT credits) and manage ES payments/safe harbors

Multi-state & SALT: calculate apportionment, manage nexus updates, composite/non-resident returns, and PTE/SALT cap workaround elections where applicable

Credits & elections: surface and document opportunities (R&D, 179/bonus choices, accounting method changes, late elections relief memos)

Fixed assets & depreciation: maintain Form 4562 schedules, asset ledgers, and disposal/partial disposition rules; reconcile book vs. tax depreciation

Quality & sign-off: build audit-ready workpapers with clear tick marks, review notes, and support; manage e-file submissions, acknowledgments, and extensions

Notices & follow-through: draft concise responses to IRS/state notices, set reminders for follow-ups, and keep clients calm with clear options and timelines

Calendar discipline: own busy-season checkpoints (intake ? prep ? review ? client Q&A ? e-file) and off-season planning (estimates, projections, method changes)



Client Collaboration

Translate code into decisions.

Join standing calls, summarize impacts (cash, rate, timing), and deliver one-page takeaways leaders can act on

Translate code citations into plain-English business decisions



Workflow & Process

Build the systems that make the busy season survivable.

Standardize SOPs, checklists, and review gates

Set up rules and automations in tax and accounting tools to reduce manual steps

Capture wins in a living playbook



Data Integrity

Leave a trail anyone can follow.

Keep folders organized, naming consistent, and documentation complete so any reviewer or auditor can follow your work quickly



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline

3+ years of U.S. tax experience preparing and reviewing 1040, 1065, 1120, 1120-S

Strong command of U.S. federal and state tax rules; comfort with GAAP and IRS procedures

Tax software proficiency: ProConnect, UltraTax, Drake, Lacerte, or similar

Cloud-first toolkit: QuickBooks Online, Xero; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivots)

Confident written and spoken English; client-facing presence

Comfortable working U.S. business hours (night shift, PH-based)



Preferred (nice to have):

HNW 1040s (K-1s, Schedule C/E), multi-state, consolidated or international exposure (GILTI/FTC)

Form 990 (nonprofits) and Form 1041 (Estates & Trusts) experience or familiarity



HOW WE WORK

Quality: Review notes, standardized workpapers, and tidy supporting schedules — every time

Security: MFA, least-privilege access, and secure file sharing are non-negotiable

Collaboration: Slack/Zoom/Teams standups, shared task boards, and predictable review cycles



WHY CAS IS DIFFERENT

We are not a gig platform. We are not a freelance marketplace. We are not short-term staffing.

We invest in professionals who want to build a real career serving U.S. clients. At CAS, you get:

Career-level USD compensation: $1,800–$2,900 USD/month based on experience and scope

Permanent remote work — done right

Full company equipment provided (laptop, monitor, accessories)

15 days PTO annually + local holidays off

Guaranteed annual increases

Referral rewards up to $1,000

Monthly flexible stipend (CAS Flex Perks)

Structured onboarding and support

A culture that actually shows up



CONTRACT & EXCLUSIVITY

This is an independent contractor engagement based in the Philippines. Full-time exclusivity is required — candidates must not hold other part-time or freelance engagements once hired. Conflict-of-interest checks may apply.



APPLICATION PROCESS

Application & Prescreening

Technical Assessment

Profile and Pre-interview Preparation

Client Interview

Employment Offer and Onboarding



READY TO TAKE THE NEXT STEP?

Your next big career move starts here.

title: Social Media Manager + Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Read this before applying



I am not looking for someone to make a content calendar and post three times a week. I delete those applications.



I am looking for someone who understands why one video gets 400,000 views and the one next to it gets 800. If you cannot explain that difference in specific terms, this is not your job.



=== About the accounts ===



You will run two brands across four platforms: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and
.



Account 1: Houston Meerdink, personal brand (80% of posts)



I am 25 years old, I own a roofing company, and I am building wealth young. The content covers roofing, AI, entrepreneurship, and business, and what it actually takes to build something at my age. Roofing is a real pillar here, not just background. The trade itself, storm work, insurance claims, running crews, and what the business actually looks like from the inside.



This is the primary account and it gets the majority of your effort.



The main KPI is not views. It is making young men watch my content and want to come work for me. Every video should build the case that I am someone worth following and worth working under. Views that do not move that needle are worthless to me.



Account 2: MCO Roofing, company page (20% of posts)



Residential roofing in Kansas City. We sell roof replacements through insurance claims after hail storms.



This account has two jobs: make homeowners trust us with their roof, and reinforce the recruiting message so people want to work for the company, not just for me personally.



Keep the two voices distinct. The personal brand is sharper, more opinionated, more personality-driven. The company page is credible and trust-building. Do not blur them.



Weekly output targets



24 new original pieces per week. Fully edited short-form video cut from footage I provide. Each piece is posted across all four platforms with captions written natively for each one, never copy-pasted.



24 lightweight pieces per week. Carousels, plus text-overlay variations built on existing text-free masters. The master is one visual and we run multiple text and hook versions off it to test what lands. Low edit time, high output.



Trial reels. The text-overlay variations get run as Instagram trial reels so we test hooks against non-followers before anything goes wide. You own that process and you read the results.



Long-term target: roughly 1,000 total posts, about 200 to 250 per platform.



Responsibilities



Short-form video editing. The bulk of this job. Fast cuts, punch-ins, word-by-word captions, sound design, B-roll, motion text, trend audio. CapCut or Premiere Pro. You should turn raw phone footage into a finished Reel that looks like it came from a US creator, not a template.



Long-form repurposing. I record long interviews, talking-head sessions, and walkthroughs. You mine them for the 8 to 12 
nts that can stand alone and cut each into a vertical short. You find the 
nts yourself. I am not timestamping anything for you.



Kick stream clipping. I stream on Kick. You pull the clippable 
nts and cut them for short-form.



Long-form YouTube editing. 5 to 20 minute videos with retention pacing, chapters, and thumbnails.



Master and variation workflow. Build text-free masters, produce hook and text variations off them, run them as trial reels, read the data, promote the winners.



Carousels. Design and copy.



Full account management. Posting on schedule across both accounts and all four platforms. Native captions per platform. Hashtag and keyword strategy. Comments, DMs, and community engagement.



Strategy. You bring me the weekly content plan, not the other way around. Monthly you show me the numbers, what is working, what to kill, and what we should film next.



Trend research. You actively watch what is performing in roofing and trades, AI, business, founder content, and male-audience short-form in the US. You send me swipe files. You know what sound is climbing before it peaks.



What I provide



Long-form videos, raw footage, talking-head recordings, walkthroughs, and Kick stream VODs. I film. You cut.



Requirements

At least 2 years editing short-form vertical video, with a portfolio of that specific work. Not weddings, not corporate explainers, not logo animations.

You have personally grown a social account, yours or a client's. You will show me the account and the before and after numbers.

Written English strong enough to write captions that sound like an American creator, not a press release.

You understand US short-form culture, roofing and trades content, business and AI content, and what a 24-year-old American guy actually finds compelling. Most applicants fail here.

Reliable internet and a computer that can edit video at this pace. Tell me your specs.

Available during US Central morning hours.

Nice to have

Experience with personal brand or founder-led accounts

AI or business content experience

Roofing, home services, construction, or trades content

Kick or Twitch clipping

Real estate

Thumbnail and graphic design (Photoshop, Canva, Figma)

Motion graphics

Paid social creative

Scripting ability

Tools



CapCut, Premiere Pro, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack or WhatsApp, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Creator tools, YouTube Studio, Canva.



How we work



I have a documented content system. We find high-performing videos, break down exactly why they worked, adapt them to the brand, film in batches, edit to a written brief, then review the numbers weekly and kill what fails. You plug into that system in month one. As you prove judgment, you take more of it over.



I am direct. I will tell you when something is bad. I expect the same from you. If you think an idea will flop, say so and tell me why.



Compensation

$1,000 to $1,500 USD per month depending on experience and proven results

Performance bonuses tied to applicants recruited and leads generated, not views

13th month pay after 12 months

Paid US and PH holidays after 90 days

This is a long-term seat. I am not interested in churning people.

How to apply



Do not send a generic cover letter. It will be deleted unread.



Send your application with the subject line: HAILSTORM - (YOUR NAME)



Answer all five of these in the body:



Link to 3 short-form videos you personally edited. Tell me which platform each was for and what it did in views.

Link to one social account you grew. Give me the starting follower count, the ending count, and the time frame.

What is the most pieces of content you have ever shipped in a single week?

Pick any viral video from a founder, business, AI, or trades creator. Send me the link and, in 5 sentences or less, tell me exactly why it worked. Be specific about the first 3 seconds.

Based on the volume above, what is your monthly rate?



Applications missing any of the five are not considered.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid test project. I send you 20 minutes of raw footage and you send me back one finished Reel within 48 hours. Paid regardless of whether I hire you.

About the Role



This role sits inside a global logistics technology company that helps e-commerce brands streamline international fulfillment. As Logistics Operations Manager, you own the daily playbooks that keep freight moving on schedule and inventory accurate, coordinating with freight brokers, reconciling inventory on receipt, ensuring timely warehouse inbounding, and applying sound judgment on the roughly 10% of daily operations that fall outside standard procedure. You are embedded directly with a growth-stage business and leadership team who need a technically strong, independent operator, with ongoing coaching, clear standards, and a dedicated Success Manager behind you so you can focus on doing excellent work.

This is a dedicated, full-time role designed for meaningful impact, stability, and professional growth in logistics and cross-border operations.

title: Logistics Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



This role sits inside a global logistics technology company that helps e-commerce brands streamline international fulfillment. As Logistics Operations Manager, you own the daily playbooks that keep freight moving on schedule and inventory accurate, coordinating with freight brokers, reconciling inventory on receipt, ensuring timely warehouse inbounding, and applying sound judgment on the roughly 10% of daily operations that fall outside standard procedure. You are embedded directly with a growth-stage business and leadership team who need a technically strong, independent operator, with ongoing coaching, clear standards, and a dedicated Success Manager behind you so you can focus on doing excellent work.

This is a dedicated, full-time role designed for meaningful impact, stability, and professional growth in logistics and cross-border operations.



Responsibilities

• Execute daily logistics operations playbooks, applying independent judgment on the estimated 10% of cases that fall outside standard procedure

• Source and compare freight brokerage quotes, balancing delivery timelines against cost to secure the best option for each shipment

• Coordinate directly with freight brokers to confirm bookings, track shipments in transit, and resolve delays

• Reconcile inventory upon receipt, verifying quantities and condition against purchase orders and manifests

• Ensure timely warehouse inbounding, coordinating with warehouse teams to prevent processing bottlenecks

• Review commercial invoices for accuracy on cross-border shipments before they move forward

• Apply working knowledge of HS codes to classify shipments correctly and avoid customs delays

• Maintain accurate records in internal operations tools and calculators used for daily decision-making

• Flag discrepancies, delays, or exceptions to the appropriate internal team promptly and clearly

• Support ad hoc logistics projects and process improvements as the business scales

• Adapt quickly as priorities shift, maintaining dependable throughput across all daily operational tasks



Qualifications

• Background in logistics, freight, or e-commerce operations (must-have)

• Working understanding of HS codes and customs classification (must-have)

• Familiarity with commercial invoices and cross-border shipping documentation (must-have)

• Ability to run daily operational playbooks independently, exercising judgment where needed (must-have)

• Strong attention to detail and consistent, dependable daily throughput (must-have)

• Comfortable coordinating directly with freight brokers and vendors (must-have)

• Experience with inventory reconciliation processes preferred

• Experience with internal ops software, calculators, or WMS platforms preferred



Tools You'll Use

• Freight and Logistics: freight brokerage coordination and quoting systems (must-have)

• Trade Documentation: HS code references and commercial invoice systems (must-have)

• Inventory: warehouse and inventory reconciliation tools (must-have)

• Internal Systems: company operations tools and calculators (must-have), plus WMS platforms where available



Benefits

• Competitive salary

• Paid US holidays

• Paid wellness days

• Health and wellness allowance

• Monthly profit sharing

• Long-term placement with real growth

• Continuous upskilling in AI and logistics operations

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
Job Summary



The Credentialing Specialist will manage, verify, and maintain the professional licenses, certifications, and insurance network enrollments for healthcare client accounts. This role acts as a primary source verification agent, ensuring that all healthcare providers meet strict regulatory, state, federal, and payer compliance requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proficient at navigating insurance applications and government portals.



Core Responsibilities



Primary Source Verification: Validate provider licensures, certifications, board credentials, education, and work history.

Application Processing: Complete and submit high-volume enrollment applications for government (Medicare, Medicaid) and commercial payers.



Database Maintenance: Update and maintain precise data fields across CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and internal software.



Expiration Tracking: Proactively monitor provider expiration dates for DEA, state licenses, and malpractice insurance.

Discrepancy Resolution: Identify potential onboarding delays, research missing file documentation, and resolve issues.



Payer Follow-Up: Contact Managed Care Organizations (MCOs) and commercial plans regularly to track application statuses.



Audit Support: Assist in preparing required provider files and scoring checklists for accreditation reviews and audits.

Client Communication: Serve as a primary point of contact for providers, medical staff offices, and client leadership.



Required Skills & Qualifications

Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate or Bachelor's degree preferred.



Experience: Minimum 1–3 years of direct healthcare credentialing or medical provider enrollment experience.



Technical Skills: Proficiency using specialized credentialing software (Credentialing Spectrum) and Google Sheets, Google Drive, FrontAPP



Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of NCQA, Joint Commission, CMS, and state licensing board requirements.



Data Integrity: Extreme attention to detail with an exceptionally low error rate in high-volume data entry.



Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills for interacting with providers and insurance companies.



Confidentiality: Demonstrated capability to securely manage and process highly sensitive, confidential personal data.



Preferred Certifications

Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) through NAMSS.

Certified Professional Medical Services Management (CPMSM).
