title: Part-Time Production Designer & Client Support Assistant
description:
We are a U.S.-based branding and marketing agency looking for a dependable, skilled production designer and client support assistant for a long-term, part-time position.



This role supports both our marketing agency and a growing network of multi-location businesses in North America. Our ideal candidate is comfortable creating professionally designed marketing materials, following established brand standards, handling routine support requests, updating existing website pages, and completing assigned production work independently.



Schedule and Pay:



$8/hour

Up to 20 hours/week

Up to 4 hours per day, Monday–Friday 



The workload varies. Some weeks include several quick support or production requests. Other weeks may include larger assignments requiring several focused hours over multiple days, with a reasonable deadline based on the scope of the project. We expect regular, meaningful progress throughout scheduled work periods.



Primary Responsibilities



Monitor and respond to routine client support requests.

Create flyers, signs, social media graphics, menus, promotional materials, and other branded collateral.

Edit and adapt existing designs for various locations, events, or promotions.

Follow established brand guidelines and existing visual styles.

Make basic WordPress website updates, including text changes, image updates, alt tags, and other entry-level website tasks.

Upload and format website content and images.

Resize, crop, organize, name, and export design files correctly.

Complete routine marketing, spreadsheet, and administrative production tasks.

Communicate clearly when instructions are unclear or additional information is needed.

Keep assigned work organized and provide a brief daily progress update.



Support requests are always the first priority. When support volume is light, remaining work time may be used for assigned design, website, marketing, and administrative projects.



Required Skills



Strong Canva skills (critical to this role).

Good understanding of typography, spacing, alignment, visual hierarchy, and layout.

Experience creating polished, publication-ready promotional flyers and marketing materials.

Strong written and spoken English.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to follow detailed instructions and meet established brand standards and requirements.

Ability to remain focused on longer assignments.

Dependable Monday-through-Friday availability for up to four hours per day.

Reliable internet connection and computer.





Preferred Skills:



Canva

Adobe Illustrator.

Adobe Photoshop.

WordPress, including front-end text and image updates.

Basic HTML or Bootstrap familiarity is a plus.

Experience supporting a marketing agency is preferred.

Experience working with franchises or multi-location businesses is preferred.

Experience handling customer or internal support requests is preferred.



This is not a senior brand strategist or creative director role. We are looking for someone with a good design eye who can reliably execute ongoing professional work within an established brand system.





A successful person in this role:



Reads the complete assignment before beginning.

Produces thoughtful, polished work rather than submitting the first rough draft.

Notices missing information or conflicting instructions.

Asks useful questions when needed.

Maintains organized and editable source files.

Checks spelling, dates, times, sizes, and required details.

Communicates well regarding scheduling, turnaround times, and challenges encountered.

Completes meaningful work during scheduled work periods.

Can move between support, design, website, and production tasks as needed.





How to Apply / Please include:



A portfolio is absolutely required and must contain at least three examples of flyers, brochures, menus, posters, social graphics, or other promotional materials you personally created.

A brief explanation of your role in creating those pieces.

Your experience using Canva, Illustrator, Photoshop, and WordPress.

Your current work schedule and whether you have other active clients or employers.

Confirmation that you are available for up to four hours per day, Monday through Friday.

Why a part-time role like this is the right fit for you.



Please do not submit only logo designs or illustration work. We specifically want to see promotional layouts, event flyers, marketing collateral, or production design work to be considered.



The selected candidate will begin with a 90-day evaluation period. Work will be assigned based on current business needs and paid at $8 USD per hour, up to 20 hours per week. Continued assignments will depend on performance, reliability, workload, and ongoing business needs.



An independent contractor agreement will be provided for review in advance of starting work.



The contractor is responsible for providing their own computer, reliable internet access, Canva access, and any other tools needed to perform the assigned work.

title: Accountant | Remote | Full-Time | $400/month
description:
Remote Bookkeeper / Accountant — QuickBooks or Xero (Work From Home, Full-Time)



We're hiring one Bookkeeper/Accountant to handle the day-to-day books for a growing digital media company. You'll work from home permanently, report directly to leadership, and get real ownership of your work — no commute, no micromanaging, no layers of approval to get anything done.



This is a great fit if you have solid bookkeeping fundamentals and want a long-term, stable remote position where you can grow as the company does.



What You'll Do



- Record daily transactions and maintain the general ledger

- Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Reconcile bank, credit card, and payment-processor accounts (Stripe, PayPal, Wise)

- Track and categorize expenses by department

- Prepare monthly reports — P&L, balance sheet, and cash summary

- Organize contractor payout records and keep documentation audit-ready

- Support month-end close alongside our external CPA

- Keep digital files clean, labeled, and easy to find

- Stay reachable on Slack during your work hours and reply to messages within 30 minutes

- Give a short daily update on what you finished and what's blocked



What We're Looking For



- At least 1 year of bookkeeping or accounting experience

- Familiarity with QuickBooks Online or Xero (we'll train you on whichever you don't know)

- Understanding of basic double-entry accounting and bank reconciliation

- Comfortable in Google Sheets or Excel

- Good written English and clear, proactive communication

- Highly responsive during work hours — you check messages regularly and reply quickly instead of leaving them sitting all day

- Self-starting and dependable — you finish what you start, meet deadlines without reminders, and speak up early when something will be late

- Reliable internet (10 Mbps or better)

- Accurate, organized, and willing to ask questions when something looks off



Nice to have (not required):



- Accounting or finance degree, or units toward one

- Experience working with US-based clients



If you don't tick every box but you're accurate, dependable, and quick to learn, we'd still like to hear from you.



How We Work (Please Read Before Applying)



Because this role is fully remote, communication is a real part of the job — not an extra.



You're online and reachable during your agreed work hours. Quick replies keep everyone moving; long silences hold up payments and reports.

We expect a reply within 30 minutes during work hours — even a quick "got it, working on it" is enough.

We don't message you after hours or on weekends. Responsiveness goes both ways, and your off time is your off time.



If you prefer to disappear for hours and reply at the end of the day, this role won't be a good fit — and that's okay. We'd rather be upfront now.



What We Offer

$400 USD/month, paid on time, every time

100% work from home

Flexible start time around the required overlap hours

Annual performance review with salary increases

Training and software provided so you can do the job properly

A stable, long-term role on a team where people stay for years

A team that documents things and doesn't send 11 PM "urgent" messages



About LookUp Media LLC



LookUp Media LLC is a US-registered digital media company running a portfolio of content channels and creator brands. Our team is fully remote and mostly based in the Philippines — more than 70 people who write, edit, produce, and manage our channels every day.



Our finances have outgrown spreadsheets, which is exactly why this role exists. You won't be one of twelve people in a finance department. You'll own the books, work directly with the people making decisions, and see the impact of your work every month.



Why Work With Us



We're upfront about pay. The number is right there in the post — no guessing games.

We're long-term. Most of our team has been with us for years on real contracts.

We respect your time. Clear expectations, documented processes, no surprise weekend work.

There's room to grow. As we scale, this role grows into a senior finance position with pay to match.



How to Apply



To apply, please fill out our short application form here: 



It takes about 5 minutes. You'll be asked for your resume, your accounting software experience, and a few short questions about how you work.



Please note: applications sent only as a message, without the form, will not be reviewed. Completing the form is the first step of the process — it tells us you read the post and follow instructions.



We review completed forms within 3 business days and reply to everyone, whether or not you move forward. We're interviewing now and will close this posting once we've hired.



Apply today. This role is filled on a first-qualified, first-hired basis.



LookUp Media LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and hire based on skills, experience, and fit for the role.

mbers regarding client progress.

mber or insurance agent.

title: Trade Operations Administrator
description:
About the Role



We're hiring a Trade Operations Administrator to run the daily rhythm of a maintenance and repair operation serving real estate agencies and their tenants across Queensland. This role sits at the center of a fast-moving trade office, working the inboxes, coordinating field staff, booking and confirming jobs, notifying tenants, and keeping KPI tracking current. You'll be the primary point of contact for tenants, agencies, and tradespeople throughout the day, keeping jobs moving and giving local leadership room to focus on the bigger picture.



This is a dedicated, full-time position built for meaningful impact, stability, and long-term growth. You'll own the operational heartbeat of the business, with training on our internal tools and a clear path to expand your responsibilities as trust builds.



Responsibilities



- Inbox management: Work the main
 inbox and enquiries inbox to zero at the start of the day, after lunch, and before sign-off. Enter new enquiries into Tradify and follow up on anything still open.

- Tenant communication: Answer tenant phone calls and text messages, and divert the work phone to the local team at the end of each day.

- Scheduling: Build the daily job schedule and assign jobs to the right tradesperson, then send entry notices to tenants ahead of scheduled work and confirmation
s for H&U and TBG jobs.

- Job readiness: Confirm every job carries the details the tradesperson needs before arriving, including quote instructions, job notes, whether the tenant will be home, lockbox codes, and any special order materials or equipment.

- Reschedules: Reschedule or cancel jobs when plans change, and text affected tenants the same day.

- Staff coordination: Call each tradesperson individually every morning to check how the day looks, flag urgent jobs, and catch problems early. Report back in the daily sync meeting with anything that needs a decision.

- Access and logistics: Arrange key pickups, lockbox codes, and tool collection with agencies and staff.

- Agency relationships:
 agencies about keys to be collected and lockbox codes. Call agencies about outstanding invoices and quotes, confirm payment dates, resend anything that went missing, and explain where pending quotes stand.

- Reporting and data: Update invoice, work order, and quote KPIs in the Real Estate Database and KPI sheet. Add new agencies, property managers, and
 addresses to the same database. KPI sheets should be current every Monday.

- Agency outreach: Run outreach
s to agencies by region using approved templates and BCC format.

- AI-assisted drafting: Use Claude AI to draft entry notices and routine
s, then review and approve each one before it goes out.

- End-of-day checklist: Sign off only after confirming both inboxes are empty, keys and lockbox codes are sorted and recorded in every job description, and any incomplete job has been rescheduled with the tenant texted.

- First 90 days: Both inboxes cleared three times a day without prompting, entry notices and job confirmations going out on schedule with no missed tenants, and scheduling and follow-up owned end-to-end.



Requirements



- Clear spoken and written English, as this role speaks with Australian tenants and property managers by phone every day (must-have)

- Comfortable making outbound calls to tenants, tradespeople, and agency staff (must-have)

- Follows a schedule and a checklist without being reminded, and flags immediately when something is behind (must-have)

- Available to start the workday at 7:30 AM Brisbane time (must-have)

- Willing to learn new software quickly and ask questions when a process is unclear (must-have)

- Customer service, dispatch, property management, or trade office experience preferred



Tools You'll Use



- Docs & Spreadsheets: Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Outlook (must-have)

- Job Management & Field Ops: Tradify, Connecteam, and XeroMe (training provided)

- AI Drafting: Claude AI



Benefits

- Paid holidays

- Paid wellness days

- Health & wellness allowance

- Monthly profit sharing

- Real opportunity for long-term growth

- Continuous upskilling in AI and trade operations coordination
